notes.title: Changes to Matchmaking and Channel Operation
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Freestyle2 Operations Team.

First, we would like to thank all players who continue to love and support
Freestyle2.

Over the past year, we have been running the Solo Queue auto-matchmaking
system to expand the player pool and improve matchmaking efficiency.

While this system provided faster matchmaking, it also created challenges
such as reduced match quality and decreased satisfaction among intermediate
and advanced players.

We have continuously reviewed these issues through surveys, community
feedback, and internal data analysis.
Your feedback has always been a valuable reference for us.

As a result, we have decided to separate the Pro and Amateur channels
once again:

[color=orange]1. Amateur Channel[/color]
→ Maintains Solo Queue auto-matchmaking for beginner and casual players
→ Provides a fast and accessible gameplay environment without burden

[color=orange]2. Pro Channel[/color]
→ Enables room creation and team-based matchmaking for experienced players
→ Offers higher-quality matches and greater strategic depth

This change is based on our past year of experience, player feedback, and
in-depth matchmaking analysis. It represents an adjustment to provide a
better gameplay environment.

The changes are scheduled to be applied during the [color=yellow]September 3[/color] (Wed)
maintenance. If there are any changes to the schedule, we will provide
additional announcements.

We will continue listening to our players’ voices, striving to provide an
enjoyable, fair, and immersive gameplay experience.
 
=================================================
 
 
Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!
 
~ Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: August Balance Hotfix
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c449138984370679ec5b8d7465bd185da3eeacb4.png

Hello!

This is the Freestyle 2 Development Team.

A balance hotfix will be applied to address issues identified after the August 13th patch.

Since the August 6th balance patch, we have been closely monitoring various play patterns and stat efficiency changes.

During this process, we identified parts where the efficiency was excessively higher or lower than intended and will be making adjustments accordingly.

The Freestyle 2 Development Team will continue to monitor the game to provide a more enjoyable and pleasant environment, and we will apply necessary improvements quickly.

Please check the detailed changes below and feel free to share your feedback on the balance patch.

~ After the balance patch, the “Defensive Power Forward” trait skill for PF
positions will be reset. Please check your trait skills before playing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4ea4e78f18d64e07bb18e761206ef02457e600cc.png

1. Skill Balance Adjustments
→ [Fast Drift Shot] The base speed of the Fast Drift Shot skill will be slightly reduced.

2. Play Coefficient Adjustments
A. Physical Contact Stat Adjustments
→ In driving situations, the collision range based on the physical contact stat will be reduced.
→ The general collision range for positions other than big men (C, PF, CT) will be reduced.

B. Steal Coefficient Adjustments
→ Steal efficiency will be slightly reduced compared to the August 6th patch.

3. Trait Skill Adjustments
A. Rebound & Block Center (C)
→ Added a stat that reduces the motion of the Box-Out Swim Move.

B. 3-Point Specialist Shooting Guard (SG)
→ When equipping the “Jab Step Timing Fake Enhancement” skill in the [Main] stage, 
it will now be possible to chain Side Step Back with X and C inputs.

C. Defensive Power Forward (PF)
→ The “Power Alley-oop” skill will be moved from the [Legend] stage to the [All-Star] stage.
→ The “Power Rebound” skill’s “Power Rebound Range Increase” stat will be adjusted. (+36 → +24)

4. Other Balance Adjustments
→ [Shot Arc Probability Adjustments] When big men (C, PF, CT) are in close-range contests near the basket,
the probability of a high-point arc trajectory will increase.

=================================================

Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!

- FreeStyle 2 Team

notes.title: 2025 Summer Season Balance Patch Developer's Note
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b56435479e7bcd3187f6de5a341fa49c196c6ec3.png

Hello, this is the Freestyle2 Development Team.

How is everyone doing during this especially hot summer?

Thanks to your continued support and enthusiasm, we've been working
hard—so much so that we barely notice the heat ourselves! To help you beat the
summer heat even in-game, we've prepared a set of refreshing updates.

We’d like to walk you through the key components of the 2025 Summer Balance
Patch, including:

- Trait System Overhaul
- New Skill
- Match Record's Search System
- Core Play Logic Updates

We always listen carefully to your opinions and analyze gameplay data to make
Freestyle2 more fun and balanced for everyone.

Now, let’s dive into the 2025 Summer Developer’s Note!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a629031ca25c07bf8ebe51de378b9402b32c05b3.png

With the upcoming update on Wednesday, July 30, the Trait system will shift
to a seasonal format, meaning trait skills will only be available for use during a
specific period.

During each season, different trait skills will be offered for each position with
unique concepts—giving players new ways to attack, defend, and strategize
on the court.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c2f2d1ef45d8f27d62ed586d0314632dfa1e9a5d.jpg

*The image shown is from a development build and may change upon
release.

In addition, skills that were previously exclusive to certain positions will now be
available across multiple positions depending on the season, enabling broader
and more unique playstyles.

The goal of this seasonal trait system is to introduce more dynamic matchups
and interactive gameplay through newly added skills each season.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/13a907f242be30131a043e479971a4f7cc687d10.png

Next, we’d like to introduce the new skills being added in this Summer Season.
Please note that all gameplay previews shown are from an in-development build
and may change upon official release.

¦ Fast Fadeaway

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0ca5489c6d483b12ca5ee0da3eb7a571711ae8b8.gif
The Fast Fadeaway skill!

Compared to the standard Fadeaway, this version has less backward movement,
but allows for a much quicker shot release.

Use both the regular Fadeaway and Fast Fadeaway depending on the situation to
increase your chances of scoring!

¦ Fast Drift Shot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/051286562c424a9318acee4b708e4e3203cbb302.gif
The Fast Drift Shot skill!

Compared to the original Drift Shot, this version has less lateral movement, but
also allows for a faster release.

It’s especially effective when dealing with help defense.

Use it in combination with the regular Drift Shot to create better scoring
chances!


¦ Power Alley-oop
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4cc0418d74b7a215a754dec7f238638a609268d8.gif
The Power Alley-oop skill (tentative name).

This skill allows you to execute an alley-oop from farther away than the
standard version.

It helps limit the range of help defense and opens up new strong inside tactics,
especially when combined with skills like the Floater.


¦ Rocker Step
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/daaecc0808d79c6b4632f16b70ad204f39c263f3.gif
The Rocker Step skill!

This allows the player to quickly break through in a desired direction using three
directional inputs (left/right).

The move is designed to simplify fake break-through inputs that beginners may
find difficult.

By buffering inputs in advance, the skill allows smoother execution.

Because the skill skips the wind-up animation, even experienced players can
enjoy quicker and more aggressive drive maneuvers depending on the situation.




¦ Skill Combo Examples
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/346b1a9050476263b05d64921377870aed322216.gif

We hope to see you pull off amazing plays using these new skills!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6019e10cf237c5155901e13994fa35f973f8e62f.png

Next, we’re introducing the Match History Search System, designed to help you
easily review all records related to your Freestyle2 gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7600579a27a4a70d63a70fb1af0b199b7f6457ca.jpg

*The screenshot shown is from a development build and may be
subject to change upon release.

This system provides a wide range of information, including:

Your character’s recent match history

Performance metric changes over time

Comparisons with seasonal averages

The ability to view other users’ character stats

As you know — information is the most powerful weapon.

Track your character’s progress through this system,
and gain insights from top-tier players to level up your gameplay even further!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3c89895b37906c44b88d3fbd9f45aa344d5d1db4.png

Lastly, to ensure even more dynamic and thrilling gameplay alongside the
above balance patch, we’re updating several aspects of the core play logic.

Key changes include:

New Shot Trajectories

Adjusted Success Rate for Shot Fakes

Tuning of Finger Block and Dunk Resistance
 
With these updates, we aim to deliver a clear and refreshing gameplay
experience for all players in the 2025 Summer Season.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/03732447fb7ab88561c8c53df9e0da6be8ca4d1e.png

=================================================

Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!


~ FreeStyle 2 Team

notes.title: Summer Season Balance Patch Rescheduled
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d323c2079970e288be50e992e24c2e1fd6ee1b7b.png
Hello, this is the FreeStyle 2 Team.

The Summer Season 1st Balance Patch, originally scheduled for Wednesday, July 30, has been rescheduled to Wednesday, August 6.

This adjustment has been made to allow for the development of additional features, ensure a more stable service environment, and improve overall patch quality.
We sincerely apologize for the sudden change in schedule and thank all players who have been patiently waiting.
We will do our best to deliver higher-quality content in return.

Please make sure to take note of the updated schedule, and we look forward to presenting the summer season patch well-prepared.

Additionally, the following improvements are planned to be included in the [color=orange]August 6 patch[/color]:


 Improved effectiveness of the Steal stat

 Fix for lag issues with the Baseball Pass
 Unification of play logic for Pro and Amateur channels, and additional entry conditions for the Amateur channel (based on position-specific MMR requirements).


Once again, we kindly ask for your understanding regarding the delay of the balance patch, and we sincerely thank all players for their continued support and love for FreeStyle 2.

– FreeStyle 2 Team

notes.title: 2025 Summer Season Update Roadmap
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/57e54f416edddc8ca991893dfb5e0939b330ccb2.png


Hello, this is the Freestyle2 Operations Team.

As we pass the halfway mark of 2025, the summer season filled
with passion hotter than the sun has officially begun.

We sincerely thank all of our players for your continuous love and support.

This summer, Freestyle2 is preparing exciting content such as:
[color=orange]System improvements
Various seasonal events
Competitive league updates[/color]

Now, let us reveal the Summer Roadmap for July and August.
Let’s check it out together!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/251bb366e7e9f003bf0653e8e05041a3c25f36a9.png
[color=cyan blue]2025.07[/color]
 - Premium Express
 - All-Star League
 - Balance Patch Part 1

[color=cyan blue]2025.08[/color]
 - New Record System
 - Balance Patch Part 2
 - Special Summer Events

[color=pink]July[/color] - A rich lineup of events including Premium Express and All-Star League,
along with the first balance patch to heat up the summer season.

[color=orange]August[/color] - Introduction of the new Record System to wrap up summer and
prepare for the fall season transition.

The development team is working hard to deliver everything as planned, and
we’ll continue to do our best to provide the best experience possible.

Stay tuned for more details in our monthly updates!
=================================================

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/25498a7d835757db53748ce6707f89e2260b4f48.jpg
First, let's talk about July.

As the beginning of the summer season, we’ve prepared a lot of content for July.
This roadmap will only cover the major updates, and more detailed information
will be shared through future update notes.

[color=violet]Premium Express[/color]
With the update on Wednesday, July 2nd, Selina and Ludrin have newly joined
the Premium Express lineup. Just by logging in, you can receive premium
characters along with the items needed for growth all for free!

Moving forward, we plan to add more characters that haven’t previously appeared
in Premium Express events.

[color=violet]All-Star League[/color]
We’re introducing a new competitive element for top-ranking players.
Players who achieve Platinum 3 or higher in Ranked Matches can compete
quarterly using All-Star League Points.

The key to the All-Star League is maintaining a certain tier each month while
also keeping a high win rate and a high number of matches.
You can aim to become the best while reducing stress from the Ranked system
through the clear point increase/decrease system unique to the All-Star League.

With the addition of the All-Star League, the Ranked Match page will also
undergo significant changes we ask for your anticipation and interest!

[color=violet]Balance Patch – Phase 1[/color]
This summer’s balance patch will roll out in phases across July and August.
Key items for July include:

- Adjustment of the ranked match calculation formula and tier ranges (7/2)
- Launch of All-Star League for top-ranked players (7/16)
- Start of the Seasonal Trait System (7/30)
- Addition of new skills (7/30)
- Rebalancing and motion point updates for certain Rare or lower-tier characters
and outdated Legendary characters (7/30)

[color=orange]The Trait System is being prepared with the following concept:[/color]
Skills will be shared across positions based on the season, allowing for a wide
variety of combinations to create new offensive and defensive playstyles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1f98f78f730d377910c3bb2e75fa9693d062d83e.jpg
Lastly, let’s take a look at what’s coming in August

In August, we plan to wrap up the summer season with the introduction of new
systems and special events.

A new Record Tracking System will be added to make your gameplay more
meaningful, and we’ll also be running cool and rewarding summer events!

There are still unrevealed details, which will be announced separately once
they’re ready.

[color=yellow]Match Record Search System[/color]
A new system that allows you to easily access all of your Freestyle match
records will be introduced.

Since information is power, you’ll be able to search and access a wide range of
data from basic match info to advanced metrics to enhance your gameplay
experience.

[color=yellow]New Performance Metrics[/color]
New stat indicators tailored to Freestyle2’s gameplay will be added.

[color=green]Victory Efficiency:[/color] A stat that reflects both win rate and total matches played
[color=green]Face-Up:[/color] A stat that highlights tight, high-pressure defense
Additionally, stats that were previously not included in MVP scoring — such as
Jump Ball Wins, Effective Resistance, and the newly added Face-Up — will now
be reflected in MVP evaluations.

Experience how defense is becoming more critical than ever in determining
match outcomes.

[color=yellow]Balance Patch – Phase 2[/color]
- Match Record Search Page Added (8/6)
- MVP Scoring System Updated with New Stats (8/6)

[color=yellow]Special Summer Event[/color]
We’ve prepared a cool event to help you beat the summer heat!
You’ll be able to claim a variety of “so cool” rewards, so don’t forget to join in!

=================================================

Everything we’ve introduced so far is part of our plan to make the
2025 SUMMER SEASON more enjoyable for all of our players.

This update goes beyond just adding new content it’s a major turning point
that aims to enhance the overall fun and completeness of the game. 
We are building this with your voices in mind and listening to every piece
of feedback you share.

We will continue doing our best to deliver experiences that exceed
expectations through ongoing communication and improvements.

Thank you as always for your continued support of Freestyle2.

- Freestyle2 Operations Team

[color=orange]How to Apply Lettering:[/color]

Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.

[color=orange]2. Color Settings[/color]

→ Bronze rank or above in the Ranked Game
→ 3 players enter from the waiting room.

[color=yellow](Conditions may be added or changed depending on the nature of each tournament)[/color]
 
→ Meet the "Conditions for Participation" of each tournament.
→ One team can only participate in one tournament.
→ When there is no waiting time for participation due to "giving up match."
→ Only the host can apply for participation.

[color=orange]Rules:[/color]
 
[color=orange]→Abandoning a Match[/color]
→ If you are participating in the tournament and force-quit a match, the match will be considered abandoned.

→ Penalties will be applied to the player who gives up a match as well as the team members.
 
[color=orange]→Penalties[/color]
a. No match reward for abandoned matches. 
b. Winning Team will not eligible to receive rewards if the opposite team
surrender or leave the match.
c. Cooldown of 1 hour applies until next tournament match.
*Other Rules follow the Regular Channel Match Rules

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bdecf17146c1dcc80e76697cb5962299a266ccdf.png

→ In case of match failure or disconnection due to PC/network issues, it will be considered as a loss.

→ Any other issues that arise will be addressed promptly, and any changes or updates will be communicated through notices.

===============================================================================
 
Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!

~ Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: Title System Update
notes.notes:
The [color=darkorange]Title System[/color] Update is Here!

 
We’ve overhauled the [color=darkorange]Title System[/color] to give you more customization and flexibility in how you showcase your achievements.

With a new interface, improved title grades, and the introduction of a brand-new system, it's time to level up your title game in FreeStyle 2!
 
Check out the details below!
 
Title System Update
→ The title system has been updated.
→ You can check the screen via Lobby > Profile > Title Settings (Gear icon),
or Locker Room > Title tab.
→ A new title system [Combination Title] has been added, and existing titles are now classified as [color=yellow][Complete Titles][/color].

[color=gold]Title[/color]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6dd1a69954aff3c1af2f2cb7c3bb110b1d38c0c9.png
~ Complete Titles and Combination Titles cannot be equipped at the same time.

[color=orange](I) Complete Titles[/color]
→ These are titles obtained before the April 23 (Wed) update, and are
owned at the account level.
→ You can equip up to 1 title.

[color=orange](II) Combination Titles[/color]
→ These are divided into 3 parts, and up to 3 can be combined and
equipped.
→ Account-wide titles can be used by all characters once used from the
Locker Room, while character-specific titles can only be used by the character
that uses the item in the Locker Room.

[color=gold]Title Grades[/color]
→ The title grade system has been improved.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/25e13a24b5f8c89386973e29454d6ce5bbe7c766.png

[color=darkorange]Item Acquisition Feature[/color]
→ After equipping a title, you can obtain one item upon completing the
assigned mission.
→ The acquired item can be used for one day, from 00:00 to 23:59.
→ Missions reset at 00:00.
→ If you equip three combination titles with the item acquisition feature,
each title’s feature is applied individually.

[color=darkorange]Title Duration[/color]
→ Titles are categorized as either time-limited or permanent.
→ When using multiple time-limited titles, the duration stacks.
→ Once a time-limited title expires, the related item will be deleted.

[color=gold]New Combination Titles[/color]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/74f8c31e2fac6209c574be6a3ed5dffe1a0c22c3.png

[color=red]~ New combination titles can be obtained through the “Master Sushi King” and “The Genesis of Cosmos: Light” events.
~ The titles [Of] and [And] are character-restricted items.[/color]

[hr][/hr]

Thank you for your continued support. 

Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!
 
~ Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: Team-Up System Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9d29b635f4bc599801ff74fef443c93be1c6cffd.png

Hey Ballers! A brand-new Team-Up System is here to shake up the court!

This update is designed to help new and casual players gain an edge
when teaming up under specific conditions. 

Check out the details on how to activate Team-Up Effects and maximize
your game!

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/00dc26461d83ad8ebc651a1e5fbd7b61701f58d9.png
 → The Team-Up System is designed to provide additional stat benefits to
beginner and casual players when they play in specific team compositions at
the start of a match.
→ Core players who are already familiar with the gameplay or those utilizing
specific tactics will not receive these benefits.
→ The Team-Up System accumulates balance data and may be adjusted
or improved through balance patches.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/96bfa6db4bbe18d482c05069dc7a0149be2c6f33.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/29d446e203bd4850fb430b33e928278e34d90d8f.png

How to Check and Set Team-Up Effects
 
[1] GSP applies only to the Amateur version
→ GSP exists only in the Auto-matching [Amateur] version of the Regular
match channel.
→ Click the Check Team Up’ button located below the [Match Start]
button to check the status.
 
 [2] Setting Method
→ Team-Up effects are automatically applied when the conditions are met.
 
Team-Up Effect Benefits
 
1. The conditions required to receive Team-Up effects must be met.
2. When playing with a designated team composition, Team-Up stat boosts
are automatically applied.
3. Once the match starts, the stat boosts will take effect.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/164ccea0e48a7e5ffbc74ba2cdc55d6c6121c338.gif
 
Eligible team compositions that receive Team-Up effects can be checked in-game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6bc048c2186409bd07b96dc87a5dd8c7eb1f9d20.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e729b0f6439c2cc20dd56a931777ed238ec7a6e4.gif

Important Notes:

→ The Team-Up System applies to the Pro Channel, Amateur Channel
auto-matching, and private team matchmaking with 1-2 players.
(It does not apply to Tournament Channels, Tournaments, or
Domination Mode.)
→ In the Amateur Channel, the system checks Team-Up conditions only after
a match is found; before that, it will be displayed as inactive.
→ The system will not apply if matched with AI in the Amateur Channel.
→ In the Pro Channel, Team-Up effects are determined based on the average
MMR of the three characters in the room. Teams with a high average MMR
will not receive benefits.
→ The system evaluates skill levels based on the highest MMR character
within a user’s account, relative to the current character’s position in the
waiting court.
→ If there is a large gap between low MMR and high MMR users,
benefits will not be applied.
→ If the skill gap among team members is too large, the Team-Up System
will not activate.
→ Detailed Team-Up conditions can be checked via the Team-Up pop-up.
→ If a team is eligible for the Team-Up System, the Team-Up effect will
be displayed after the entrance scene.
→ Eligible team compositions for Team-Up effects are pre-defined
and may be adjusted through balance patches.
 
===============================================================================

With the Team-Up System, beginner and casual players can enjoy a smoother
and more competitive experience. Now, hit the court, team up, and show off
your skills! 

Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!


- FreeStyle 2 Team

notes.title: Stabilization Notice Regarding Game Usage Issues on Windows 11 Version 24H2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5f46e993f2db6b9c5d05bf2dfccd948ac1f3c664.png


Dear, Ballers!

This is the Freestyle 2 Operations Team.

We have analyzed the intermittent abnormal game termination issue that has
been continuously occurring due to compatibility problems with the
Windows 11 version 24H2 environment.

The development team has identified that certain features of the external
libraries used in Freestyle 2 are causing compatibility issues with the latest
Windows 11 update version.

Currently, the problematic features have been fixed and applied, and since
the implementation, we have confirmed that the intermittent abnormal
game termination issue has been significantly alleviated.

We sincerely apologize once again to everyone who experienced inconvenience
due to this issue.

Furthermore, the development team is continuously monitoring the situation
to account for the possibility of additional issues occurring even after the fix.

If you continue to experience the above issue after the fix, please report it
through a 1:1 inquiry to our customer support center.

Email: steam_support@gamekiss.com

We will strive to provide a more stable gaming environment for all players.

Thank you for your continued support.


- The FreeStyle 2 Team

notes.title: Windows 11 24H2 Version Unexpected Shutdown Issue
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/64ca1ba745e6a719d9bfd45e367547da74acc483.png

Hello, this is the Freestyle2 Operations Team.

We are currently aware that some users are experiencing compatibility issues
with the Windows 11 24H2 operating system version, causing the client to
unexpectedly shut down frequently.

The Freestyle2 development team has also recognized this issue and is actively
working to resolve it based on the information provided by affected users.

Additionally, it has been identified that similar compatibility issues
with Windows 11 are affecting other games as well.
Microsoft is currently investigating the issue to find a resolution.

According to the findings of the development team so far,
it appears that the game runs stably on versions of Windows other than 24H2.

We kindly ask you to refrain from updating to the 24H2 version, if possible,
until the issue is resolved. We will provide updates regarding the resolution of this problem 
via a notice on our website as soon as it is addressed.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused and deeply appreciate
your continued love and support for Freestyle2.

The Freestyle2 team will continue to strive to repay your affection and trust
with our utmost efforts.

Thank you.

~ Freestyle 2 Team

Unleash the Yin-Yang Master: Sherbet Joins FreeStyle 2!

In this exciting new update, FreeStyle 2 welcomes Sherbet, a powerful Yin-Yang
Master, alongside her unique form, Sherbet Majesty. Sherbet’s legacy
flows from her family’s heritage of mastery over yin and yang, a skill passed
down through generations. 

Harnessing the perfect balance of yin and yang, Sherbet’s abilities bring
transformative buffs to her team, making her an invaluable asset on the court.

This is your chance to recruit a character like no other—one who embodies
the magic and mystery of ancient lore with unstoppable energy.

Are you ready to feel the thrill of Sherbet’s celestial power?
Join the action and witness the dawn of a legend!

notes.title: October Update and Improvements
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cfb6038988bcce24f32c4c4027a42b14c4cc0d29.png

Get ready to elevate your game with the October Update!

Our team has been hard at work refining the gameplay experience based on
your feedback. These updates focus on optimizing performance, balancing
contents, and enhancing overall playability.

Check out the list of improvements below to see what's been fine-tuned for
smoother, more enjoyable matches and to enhance your gameplay experience.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b881b80a4c3648b66ea373f6183051ddafc79df8.gif
[color=cyan]1. AI Skill Usage Probability Setting[/color]
→ The AI is designed to set the probability of using specific skills in certain
situations based on difficulty levels, making its playstyle as similar to human
players as possible

[color=cyan]2. Situation Setting[/color]

[color=orange]A. Offensive Situations:[/color]
→ When the AI is in possession of the ball and in a shooting scenario, it is set to
use specific types of shots based on the situation
a Close-range dunk
b. Long-range dunk
c. Mid-range shot
d. 3-point shot
e. Specific skill
f. If unable to attempt a shot, the AI will pass to a teammate.

[color=orange]B. Passing Situation:[/color]
→ Set to use a specific type of pass when passing to a teammate.
a Regular pass
b. Specific skill
c. If the specific skill cannot be used, the AI will perform a regular pass

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8aeae09e94ef11b0188d6a92fdbb8c16d73488bc.gif
[color=cyan]1. Match Record[/color]
→ Adjusted so that the most recent match record is always displayed when
entering the match record menu
 
[color=cyan]2. My Stats[/color]
→ Adjusted so that the most recent match record is always displayed when
entering the match record menu
 - Display the most recently earned trophy
 
[color=cyan]3. Ranking[/color]
→ Modified to display all ranking information for each match

[color=cyan]4. Character Note[/color]
→ Modified the display of earned championship trophies and the way match
records are shown in the character note

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/70844354e4b21aa03f8f5f7edaad1dd8fe791dc2.gif

notes.title: 2024.07.24th July Balance Patch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/87f2f045edd680a344de7439282b1b3170bede45.png

Hello, Ballers!
 
This is the FreeStyle2 Development Team.
 
A Balance Hotfix patch will be implemented to address issues identified after
the 7/10 patch. We are currently reviewing various aspects, including player
trends, unintended gameplay mechanics, and balance data following the
July balance patch.

Please check the details of the changes below and feel free to leave your
feedback regarding the balance patch.
 
*After the balance patch, the 'Drift Shot SF' Mastery skill for the SF position
will be reset. Please check your Mastery skills before playing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ec7b9df7e751d858c4a61c47a8a5b32fc48d8a33.png
1) Gameplay Balance Changes
 
A. Cross Hop Step (SF)
→ A coefficient has been added to make the Cross Hop Step basic skill affected
by the Drive Speed attribute.
 
→ The coefficient for the Cross Hop Step enhanced Mastery skill has been
modified to be more influenced by the Drive Speed attribute.
 
B. Straight-line Drive (SF)
→ The coefficient for the Straight-line Drive Mastery skill has been modified
to be more influenced by the Drive Speed attribute.
 
→ The coefficient for the Straight-line Drive enhanced Mastery skill has been
modified to be more influenced by the Drive Speed attribute.
 
C. Ball Handler Team Formation Adjustments
1) If there are 2 or more ball handlers on the HOME team, the attributes
of the ball handler positions will be decreased.

Ball Handlers:
Defensive Dual Guard, Block Point Guard, Steal Point Guard,
PG, and DG positions without specialties equipped.
 
2) Decreased Attributes
   - Move Speed -20%
   - 3pt Shot Success Rate -20%
 
D. Diving Off
→ The skill hotkey will be changed.
 
  - Before: [W] key when loose ball is available.
  - After: [R] key when loose ball is available.

2) Balance Changes & Error Fixes
 
A. Changes to Results Display
→ An issue where match results were not displaying correctly has been fixed.
- Jump Ball & Effective Resistance Records.
 
B. Back Roll Turn Pull-up Jumper (Mastery Skill)
1) An issue where the skill would activate even when the Enhanced Pull-up
Jumper Mastery isn’t equipped has been fixed.
 
2) An issue where the Enhanced Pull-up Jumper would activate when
using the Back Roll Turn Pull-up Jumper has been fixed. 
 
C. Last Resistance Upgrade (Mastery Skill)
→ The probability condition in the activation requirements for the enhanced
Last Resistance Upgrade skill has been changed.
 
  a. Before
  - Big Man (C, PF, CT) will be affected by the Last Resistance skill if they
    possess the ball for more than 0.8 seconds.
      → Last Resistance Activation Success Rate
      - 0.8s: 40% Chance
      - 1s: 50% Chance
      - 2s: 100% Chance
 
  b. After
  - Big Man (C, PF, CT) will be affected by the Last Resistance skill if they
    possess the ball for more than 0.8 seconds.
    → Last Resistance Activation Success Rate
      - 0.8s: 53% Chance
      - 1s: 67% Chance
      - 1.5s: 100% Chance
 
D. Paint Zone Middle Shot Adjustment
→ Fixed an issue where shot resistance was applied significantly lower
when taking middle shots from the paint zone.
 
E. Status Indicator Icon Update
→ A status icon will be displayed under characters during gameplay.
  - Last Resistance Upgrade Activation Availability Status
    (Only the time condition will be displayed.)
  - Interrupt Skill Activation Availability Status.
 
F. Growth Guide
→ A Balance tab has been added to the Growth Guide.
→ We will continue to update and provide more detailed
explanations regarding balance changes in the future.

=================================================

Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!

- Freestyle2 Team

notes.title: Bug Fix Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5f46e993f2db6b9c5d05bf2dfccd948ac1f3c664.png

Dear, Ballers!

We would like to announce the details of our latest bug fixes.

Our team has been working diligently to address various issues to ensure you
have the best possible gaming experience.

Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we appreciate your patience and
support as we strive to make continuous improvements to the game. 

Here are the specifics of the issues addressed during today's
maintenance:

1. Card Bug
→ We are fixing all issues affecting specific Defense and Offense Cards.
Please note that the affected attribute options will undergo a reset and
reassignment process.
   
i. Legend Grade Card: 
Users affected by this bug will receive 5 Premium sub-attributes and 5
Card Attribute locks.

ii. All-Star Grade Card: 
Users affected can change the attribute to their preferred option by
contacting the Support Team. However, sub-attributes cannot be
changed to the same options.
**Users cannot select the same 3 sub-attributes. 

To address this issue promptly, please submit a support ticket to
steam_support@gamekiss.com

2. Green User Skill Slot
→ Fixed the issue related to the Green User Skill Slot.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/4262175798156495291?l=english

3. Premium Express
→ Fixed the display error for Express Mission Season 1 Autumn Stage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1ab2bb1df24bf58403ab5fa91ed462853d86b9fb.png
 
4. Crew Quest Contribution
→ Fixed the visual bug related to Crew Contribution.

5. Character Performance Enhancement Attributes
→ Fixed the issue where attributes were not being displayed properly.

6. Private Mode 'Ready' Cancellation
→ Fixed the issue where you couldn’t cancel ‘Ready’ in Private Mode.

7. Miracle Mine Workers
→ Fixed the issue where Miracle Mine Workers were disappearing.
 
8. Box Out Swarm Move Stamina Usage
→ Fixed the issue where activating the Box Out Swarm Move skill used a different
amount of stamina than intended in certain situations.

9. Back Roll Turn 1 Ankle Break
→ Fixed the issue that occurred with Back Roll Turn 1 Ankle Break.
 
10. Long Range Indicator
→ Fixed the issue regarding the indicator of being within Long Range.
 
11. Training Attributes for Game Changer Characters
→ Fixed the issue where Training Attributes weren’t being properly assigned. 

Users who have already created the character will obtain random attributes, so
we are providing an optional Attribute Changer Coupon to ensure they can
select their desired attributes.
 
12. Character Motions and Waiting Room
→ Fixed the issue where equipping Character Motions and exiting the Waiting
Room caused the equipped motions to be reset.
 
13. Lightning Zip-up Hoodie
→ Fixed the outfit attribute and applied the event GKash you’ve used for the
attribute directly to your currency.
 
14. Sandman Pants Attribute
→ The attribute of Sandman Pants has been changed.
 
15. Auto Matchmaking Spectating and Crew League
→ Added Auto Matchmaking Spectating and Crew League.
 
16. Bathing Gown Visual Bug
→ Fixed the visual bug related to the Bathing Gown Outfit.

We appreciate your continued support and understanding as we work to
enhance your gaming experience.

If you have any further issues or need assistance, please do not hesitate
to contact our support team at steam_support@gamekiss.com

============================================================================

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!

- Freestyle2 Team

and rewards.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8d65d2ad8fe1685bf736d40cdd849c8e6fed3b01.png

Greetings Ballers,

This is the FreeStyle2 Development Team.

There will be a balance patch with the July 10th (UTC) summer season update.
We will continue to check for issues after the patch and if needed, apply hotfixes.
Please check the information below for details. And once again, we ask you
for your feedback and opinions regarding the balance changes.

*The Mastery Skills for all positions will be reset.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ec7b9df7e751d858c4a61c47a8a5b32fc48d8a33.png

1) New Skills
A. Fast Back Dribble
SW Position – Crossover Swingman Mastery Skill

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4e64fab91a68b0bcaaac431b4abfbb937b3f5dcf.gif

Quickly move backward during drive-through dribble to create distance from the
defense. Dribble state is maintained during this action.
Fast Back Dribble Speed increases based on the Drive Speed ↑ Attribute.
(Note: You can use the skill without equipping Fast Back Dribble.)

B. Normal / Enhanced Pull-up Jumper
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3cc227e5166d1eac6ede8b4b2161184111f648ab.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0d2cac5315271ae13ee3fba5af6a26577f10febd.gif

SW Position – Crossover Swingman Mastery Skill
Allows you to perform an extremely quick jump shot while drive dribbling.
In offensive situations, if the HOME team's C or PF position is not in the
post-push area, the regular Pull-up Jumper skill will be activated.
(You can use the skill only when you have the Pull-up Jumper skill equipped.)

C. Back Roll Turn Pull-up Jumper
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d39e6ff3a585f21a1b65761e910340073d619194.gif

SG Position – Crossover Shooting Guard Mastery Skill
Quickly perform a Fade Away shot during a back roll turn.
(Note: When using the 'Back Back Roll Turn 1' skill, you can only use the
'Backroll Pull-Up Jumper' skill if you have the 'Pull-Up Jumper' skill equipped.)

2) Mastery Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a1fbf7731b8d183a1c52fded62cf5bd09c4f1b33.png

3) Skill Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fbf4558b0d2250a4ad6604a5559796060a0b298c.png

4) Play Logic Balance Changes
A. Timing Fake Conditions Adjustment (Play Logic)
1) In offensive situations, if the HOME team's C or PF position is not in the
post-push area, Timing Fake is not applied.
 - Timing Fake is applied to the SF position’s ‘Technical Shot Master’ regardless
of HOME team’s location.
2) If there is an ‘Away Screen Move Shooting Guard’ in HOME team, Timing Fake
is not applied to ‘Quick Jumper’ in the Mid-Range Shot area.

B. Screen Body Check (Normal Skill)
1) If ‘Away Screen Move’ can be activated (MOVE tag shown), Stamina is greatly
decreased when using Screen Body Check.

C. Diving Throw (Mastery Skill)
1) The shortcut to use is change to [W].
2) The range and release point will be greatly increased compared
to ‘Diving Catch’.

D. Screen: Collision Range↑ (Attribute)
1) The range increased for each Screen: Collision Range↑ Attribute is reduced.
2) Screen: Collision Range’s effectiveness is decreased
when Screen Body Checking.

E. Side Hop Step (Normal/Mastery Skill)
1) Side Hop Step Speed increases based on Drive Speed ↑ Attribute.

F. Character Attribute (Attribute)
1) The difference in Attributes between ‘Power Type’ and
‘Balance Type’ / ‘Shrewd Type’ and ‘Balance Type’ will be decreased.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/8007791/32b97238ee4c2f284b1016e3ff4eac0cb495911a.png 

*The example attribute above represents the basic attribute value for the
Center position, without the unique effect of each character applied.

G. Last Resistance  (Normal Skill)
C, PF, and CT position are not checked under the last resistance
subbone conditions.
(When there are positions other than C, PF, and CT, the use of the
last resistance skill changes.)

H. Move Speed Increase during Defense	
1) The existing 'Move Speed Increase during Defense' Mastery is the
same as the 'Move Speed Increase during Defense' stat +19.		
2) If the Move Speed Increase during Defense is less than +19,
it is less than the speed of the existing Mastery

5. Bug Fixes
A. Long Range Shot Success Rate Revised
1) Commonly identified as a bug, the issue of relatively long range shots in certain areas has been resolved.
 
6) Balance Improvements
A. Alley-oop Pass
 - If you are pressing [V], Alley-oop Pass will not activate.

B. Training System
 - The following characters will be added to the Training System.
→ Lukas
→ Aurora
→ Unlimit Jake

C. New Records Added
 - The Season OP and Season DP after a match will be removed and
new records will be added.
→ Jump Ball: The number of Jump Balls obtained, starting from
the beginning of the game. (Excluding overtime)
→ Effective Resistance: An indicator that increases when
effective block resistance is applied to shots from the opponent.
(When multiple players have resisted, the player who have the
highest resistance will be recorded.)
 * Records such as player info, ranking, match stats, and more will be added.

D. Normal/Magic Character Attributes Enhancement
1) All parts that could be obtained through the Parts Collection Event
will be removed.
 - Normal Character Parts
 - Naughty Kitty Parts (Ginger, Nicki, Liu)
 - Black Lightning Parts (Lyn, Nick, James Kim)
 - Team Slam Parts (Gorilla, Michelle, Simon)

2) Unique Effect skills will be added for normal characters.
 - Game Changer Regular Attributes
 - All Stats +3 (All Training Stats +3)

3) Unique Effect skills will be added for magic characters.
 1> Game Changer Regular Attributes
 - All Stats +1 (All Training Stats +1)

 2> Game Changer Extra Attributes
 - Mid.Shot: success%↑ +1
 - 3pt Shot Success Rate ↑ +1
 - Drive Speed ↑ +1
 - Stamina max↑ +1
 - Stamina: recovery↑ +1
 - Move: speed↑ +1
 - Manual Block Range +1
 - Steal Speed ↑ +1

4) Parts of normal/magic characters are deleted and replaced with
unique effect skills. The added attributes may be reduced compared to
before.

- The motion change system in the character performance upgrade allows
you to exchange character motions or adjust insufficient attribute values
according to your preference.
(For more details, please refer to the 'Character Performance Upgrade' update.)
 
5) The unique effects of normal/magic characters can be adjusted for
some attributes and effects through balance patches.
 
6) Balance planning:
- The use of new skills in the training system will be updated later.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/540ab01894769df338fe8803a30b6e395b0f1f8a.gif

notes.title: 2024 Summer Season Update Roadmap
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ce93ddb0f643a94fc15b15856d365c574fda6509.png

Hello from the Freestyle 2 Dev Team!

Summer 2024 is here, and we’re excited to bring you new content to
enjoy this season. We’re working hard to prepare a variety of new features
to make your summer even more fun.

We truly appreciate your love and support for Freestyle 2.

Since our update on June 5th (PDT), we’re thrilled to share
our Summer 2024 Roadmap with you.

Here are the main points of our Summer 2024 Roadmap:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d34cf4a6b3c62df1f5b0066ebc71a77e0800ea78.png
 
June - Unlimit Jake / Establishing a foundation to reduce the power gap
between players through Parts Character Draft

July - Add parts characters to basic characters, Upgrade character performance,
Game Changer Big Update with Special Express Event

August - Summer Season 2 Big Update with Character Craft System and
Various Improvements

The Development Team will do its utmost to deliver the above content
in its best possible form.

Next, we will share the details of the Update with you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/63714403eafbe451804fb8181a3720682dee5a43.png

We will begin with the June Update.

- Draft System: Parts Characters
The Draft System was revamped in June. 
You could now receive the complete Parts Character instead of a Draft Character. 
From Saru to Helena, a total of 11 Parts Characters were made available.

[Link] Draft Season 12

- Unlimit Jake
The Wild Rookies’ Jake has returned to FS2 with major upgrades.

 
Unlimit Jake is distributed to players through an Event. We hope you
look forward to meeting him!

[Link] Unlimit Jake Update

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d761a407bfa421ece5522601a37c230f75e6e761.png
 
Next is the July Update.

In July, many new features will be introduced under
the title "Patch Name: Game Changer."

- Character Performance Upgrade
A new system that allows you to upgrade Normal, Magic, and Rare Characters
will be added. 

Over the extended period that FS2 has been in service, many original characters
have become less practical due to changes in the meta. 

To address this issue, we have developed a system that enables you to
enhance your favorite characters.

We plan to make these upgrades easily accessible, so they will be available
simply by playing the game.

However, this system will replace the Growth Mode. Following the July Update,
Growth Mode will be removed from the game. 

The existing motions acquired through Growth Mode can still be used
without any changes. Additionally, we are improving the system to make
obtaining motions easier and more enjoyable.

Stay with us! you’re in for a treat!

- Game Changer - Express Event
July 10th! Game Changer Special Main Event will be held.
We promise you a thrilling gift that you have never experienced before.
Please look forward to it!

- Summer Balance Patch
A new balance patch will arrive for the Summer Season.
New skills will be added to the game, and balance adjustments will be made
to various positions and strategies.

We will continue to bring exciting changes to the meta with consistent
balance adjustments, starting from the Summer Season and extending
through the Winter Season.

- User Benefit Revamp
We are planning to revamp some fundamental aspects of FS2. 

We’re excited to share that you can now get SP Running, SP Stamina, and
other premium skills just by playing, with no payment needed!

The Green User Benefit will finally be updated, and new products
will be added to the Shop.

Additionally, a UI update in July will make the menu easier to navigate. 

We will provide further details regarding these adjustments in
an announcement after the July Patch.

- BZ+Regular Channel Merge
We’ve heard your feedback loud and clear. 

To improve our matchmaking system, the first step we will take is to merge
the BZ and Regular channels. 

After the merge, it will operate as a Regular Channel. Various options will be
implemented to enhance the matchmaking experience. 

We hope this merge will allow our players to enjoy more quality games.

- Parts Character Distribution 
The “Game Changer” Update will allow you to create Parts Characters when
creating a character. 

We hope this update will enhance your gaming experience and deepen
your love for the game. 

However, this system will replace the Draft System. 

Following the July Update, the Draft System will be removed from the game,
and Parts Characters will also be removed from the Crystal Shop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8147fc4331f647389fb961caf9bce9c7e9bed639.png

Lastly, let’s talk about August.

The second big update of the summer season is scheduled for August,
focusing on introducing new systems and events.

- Character Craft System
The existing character creation and enhancement systems will be completely
reorganized to make it easier to create and strengthen characters.

- Equipment System
The existing equipment system will be changed to a seasonal system. 
Equipment will reset and be rebalanced every season, making the process of
acquiring equipment more meaningful and rewarding.

- Summer Season Event
We are preparing a new event to wrap up the summer season.
The event will feature various rewards and plenty of enjoyment,
so we hope you look forward to it.

- 2nd New Item Update

=============================================================================

Our 2024 SUMMER SEASON Roadmap ends here.

Our Developer Team is currently doing its best to incorporate your feedback and
brainstorm ideas to further enhance your gaming experience.

We are also very happy to share with you their plans for the summer.

We will do our utmost to ensure the promised content is added to the game in
due time.

Thank you!

Sincerely,

~ Freestyle 2 Team

Buff Types:
1. Stray Rebels characters come with a special feature: during every
Offense/Defense switch, they automatically trigger one of three types
of team-wide buffs at random.

2. Stray Rebels characters can choose one of three types of buffs,
and if the randomly selected buff during a match matches the chosen type,
the buff is enhanced to gain a Special  effect.

3 Buffs apply to all team members.

4. If the unselected buff type is activated, only obtain +1 attribute.
 
5. The buffs are divided into three types: 'Special  Buff Type,' which
utilizes Special  abilities, ‘Attribute Type,' which increases attributes,
and 'Buff & Attribute Type,' which combines aspects of both types.

6. Depending on the chosen buff type, you can earn buff motion points,
which can be used to select and change exclusive buff motions.

* The transformation/buff duration increase buffs of the Special Buff Type
do not apply to the awakened state or Selina characters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/67b1e904d06c2ee3c2fac9fb558dc335dcd076af.png

1. Special Buff Type
- A buff type Special ized in team support using Special  buffs.
- Additional buffs are activated if multiple teammates select this buff type.
- When the Special  Buff Type is chosen, you earn '13' Buff Motion Point(s).

Stamina Consumption Skill List
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/64679c6195c03fafb336977b5ced962dfa30390d.png

2. Buff & Attribute Type

- A balanced buff type that uses parts of both special buff and attribute types.
- The buffs and attribute bonuses will be added based on the number of
team members who have selected the corresponding buff type.
- When the Special Buff Type is chosen, you earn '14' Buff Motion Point(s).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f9b87efaeb50f03d12bd7d2d2320631cfc637f73.png

Buff & Attribute List

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fa9d91628deab3d5cc9e319644d1901d5e4e7c2e.png

* The list of stamina consumption skills is the same as the special buff type.
* Buff level 2's increasing att buffs are not superimposed by the
number of characters.

3. Attribute Type
- A buff type that provides attributes without special buffs.
- The amount of bonus attributes gained is enhanced if there are many
teammates who have selected this buff type.
- When the Special Buff Type is chosen, you earn '12' Buff Motion Point(s).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/701965bcec65685563e06533d717aa3b0d6ab83b.png

Attribute Type List

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f5d86362d3c7be2d30735ebdab505fa3999bdfe7.png

*Buff leve 1's training point do not overlap based on the number
of characters.		
*Buff Level 2's Extended attribute do not overlap based on the number
of characters.		
 
4. Buff Apply 

- All-stat Att +1 Incident (applies to the entire team) in jump ball situations
immediately after play		

- In a jump ball situation, one of the three Buff Types is applied
through Probability	

"At the start of each shift, we'll set up the existing types of buffs, then
randomly apply one type of buff from the three available types based
on probability."	

 
a) Apply the selected Buff Type → Apply the Enhanced Buff according
to the number of people		

b) Unselected Buff Type is applied → All-stat +1 Buff Additional Buffs
are not applied		

* One of the three types of buffs is applied due to random probability
in the shift of offense and defense due to scoring/attack time over.		

* It does not apply to changes in offensive rights due to steals,
rebounds, loose balls, blocks, etc., and the buff applied during the
corresponding airlift shifts is maintained.
 
*Only 1 Buff Type is selected for each Buff Type.

notes.title: April Update and Improvements
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ec4ef954d1e874287a478a775130bd33e87896f2.png

Welcome to the latest improvements rolled out this April! 

This update focuses on refining your gaming experience with
several enhancements, ranging from
outfit previews to character attributes visibility.

Let's delve into the key features:

1. Outfit Preview Improvements

- You can find all the costumes available at the event in the costume
preview pop-up window.
- In the case of set costumes, you can check them by installing them
at once when previewing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ff07adf4478ecf76d351a2d9cf576b2567eb9b90.gif

- However, if you try to fit an outfit that cannot be fitted through
the costume preview, the Notification Pop-up will be exposed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/aa77e58a95e194f074e5bda2364339f682a7afcb.gif

Added costume preview pop-up screen function:  

a. Initialize Mounting  

- The character will be reset to the outfit you are currently wearing. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/451214ef8838887f456a696b8cd35a6f946950f3.gif

b. History	 

- Save up to 30 recently previewed outfits. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cf76e90ce757d510607383179f2de9b5a2b9d769.gif

 c. Help  

- A Description Tooltip is created during the mouse over.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/52041c4db93745b05e00ce4145a1ef2472178b0b.gif
 
d. Costume view area  

- A character rotation function is added.  
- Zoom-in and zoom-out are possible through mouse scrolling.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bc75ddf6253f77e23fc66984ec6b6f27e5b8ead1.gif

2. Outfit Grade Update 

Introducing the All Star Grade to the existing outfit grades, 
including Normal, Magic, Rare, and Legend.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/10436e264f23e94377835ec0098aaf592a10e741.png

3. New Outfit Set Update

Capability Set Costume Features
1. Installing all the capability sets will raise the set capability values.
2. Capability values are always applied before and after the game.
3. Switching characters are only applied to switching characters
in set costumes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/94b51ad9343d2215d7c9d0b150ceff6b9b733783.png

4. Training Mode

Refreshed Training Mode button for improved accessibility and usability.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e42f4ef2e652cf1d8ca9c4b6c60b0465db3092ee.gif

Improvements:

- You can now set up to nine (9) recording presets.

5. Character Note Update

Gain insight into other users' attributes with the new character note feature.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6e2911ddbfa7abe4ddbac75d7a47ad602b33e6cf.gif

Compare and strategize to dominate the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/425eecb04af9d0b618bc337889a26ea9406250dd.gif

6. Improved Fancy Drive Master Majesty
 
The 'Fancy Drive Master' majesty improved. It has been corrected
to SG position as well.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f4d30625db099a05cf33e3a8e306474f6f49307a.gif
 
Only the crossover SW Majesty are combined with the "Fancy Drive Master"
skill with the "Fancy Drive Master Enhancement"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1b393383511056155aa0f091bdfeb0eee880bb32.gif

=============================================================

These updates aim to elevate your gaming journey by providing
more convenience, customization options, and insights into the game world.
Dive in and experience the April improvements firsthand!


~ Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: Training System Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/31c7ebe3ce6c215e5ec0af15769c37d7f9ad36d4.png

Are you ready to take your skills to the next level? Get ready for the
Training Mode, where learning meets innovation like never before! 

Training System Guide:
1. Training Bulletin Board: A place where users can share training materials
they have created.
2. Training Production: The section where users can develop and create their
own training content.
3. Training Play: Here, you can play the training you've either created yourself
or downloaded from the bulletin board.
 
Training System Details:
1. The training system provides a platform for creating scenarios and engaging
in practice sessions.
2. Settings can be shared with fellow players by posting them on the
Bulletin Board.
3. Players have the opportunity to practice training sets created by others
through the Bulletin Board postings..
4. Guidance on creating training scenarios can be accessed via the
'Training Production' screen to assist players in getting started.
5. It's important to note that if there's a balance patch affecting stats,
skills, etc., certain training scenarios may become inaccessible.
 
How to proceed to the Training Mode:

- Click on the Pactice tab located on the main lobby.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ddefd4918e05c5180c7e6a2d0e9d464439336035.png

- Then choose the Training Mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d343ee0745ab8b6caf29ace9ed4b59b7d6c69051.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ba71a2dd60c947db37213df1e14e907b1b71cae6.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cda3f9258c33cf852489de98017dbf330ef4fa50.png
Dive into the Training Bulletin Board, your go-to hub for sharing and
discovering user-created training materials.

Posting Conditions for the Training Bulletin Board
 
Posting Requirements
 - Only accounts meeting the following criteria are eligible to make a post.
  → Accounts that have won over 100 games in the Regular channel
  → Accounts that have played more than 3 games in the last 90 days
  → Accounts that have written no more than two posts in a single day
(deleted posts are counted as written.)

Commenting Requirements
 - Only accounts meeting the following criteria are eligible to write a comment.
  → Accounts that have played more than 10 games
(BZ channel, Regular channel)
  → Accounts that have played more than 30 games in the last 90 days
  → Accounts that have written no more than three comments in a single day
(deleted comments are counted as written.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9df2a0e1e1807813cd090731cd382601bd2b51db.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7f8252807c7cf96cf29da4164de4cc1ca6c00199.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d67dc1764974c135f6d326a172e7bc3416e7ba65.png
Unleash your creativity in Training Production, where you can craft your
own custom training content.

Basic Training Production Method: Basic Recording Method
1. Create an NPC character for the scenario.
 - To create an NPC character for the scenario, click the [+] button in the
'AWAY Team Member 1' section.
 - After selecting 'create', proceed to adjust the character's detailed settings.
 a. Customize the character's attributes such as position, height, and
available motions (if applicable).
 b. Load a character preset of your choice.
 c. Confirm the character creation by pressing the designated button.
 d. The character will be successfully created and integrated into the scenario.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/00a6941764a9855f0917558adc9d41b47af9002b.gif
 
2. Determine the character to be controlled by either clicking the
'Control Character (MY)' or 'AWAY Team Member 1' section.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/61d2991a0aa885e99d0fa7901bb288de90691d65.gif

3. Record the practice scenario using the NPC character.
- Establish a situation where the NPC character obtains the ball
(either by picking it up or the F8 button).
- Start the recording process by activating it via the [1] shortcut key or
by clicking the designated [Start Recording] button.
- Direct the movements of the NPC character during the recording
phase to simulate the desired actions and scenario dynamics.
- Once the intended sequence is recorded, conclude the process by
clicking the [2] shortcut key or selecting the [End Recording] button to finalize the recording.
(Once recording starts, the [2] [End Recording] button appears.)
- You can play the recorded NPC character by clicking the [3] shortcutkey
or the [Play Recording] button.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c37918e8fa7a0a02c9150a05a0c661085abaf1f1.gif
 
4. 'Control Character (MY)' creates the character the player
will operate.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e8fc05d78269c976ee5fd374373980c162a32753.gif

5. You can practice the predetermined scenario through playback
while controlling the set character.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/95f15f8b8d83aa642be86383780cb259f5143527.gif

Advanced Training Production Method: Preset Recording Method
1. Utilize the basic recording method to capture the desired scenario and save it.
2. Switch to preset 2 through the [5] shortcut key or selecting
the [Record Preset] button.
 - The first recording preset is automatically set to 1.
3. Repeat the recording process as per the basic method and save it
to preset 2.
 - You can set up to three recording presets.
4. Explore diverse scenarios by accessing the presets through
the [7], [8], and [9] buttons.

Button Function Information
All functions can be accessed by either clicking the corresponding
button or using the designated shortcut key.
[1] Shortcut key: Initiates recording.
[2] Shortcut key: Ends recording; applicable when recording.
[3] Shortcut key: Plays the action recorded from start to finish.
[4] Shortcut key: Halts the playback of the action.
[5] Shortcut key: Assigns a preset number for recording, with up to
three presets available.
[6] Shortcut key: Randomly plays one of the recorded actions within the preset.
[7] Shortcut key: Repeatedly plays the recorded action within the current preset.
[8] Shortcut key: Sequentially and repeatedly plays all recorded actions
within the preset.
[9] Shortcut key: Randomly and repeatedly plays all recorded actions
within the preset.
[0] Shortcut key: Deletes the recording stored in the preset.
[F8] Shortcut key: Makes the currently selected character hold the ball.
[F9] Shortcut key: If not in recording state, resets the action, stamina,
and ball position.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0be85cc377038118a8a8f1626b95b9a4a0b5b7d9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f1ac43b72ff75a79a049dbef8adf6581d59a2753.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ab14f2b91fe631e3a45e1a520b26962f128d3aa2.png

This is where your saved recordings are located, which you can then be initiated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ee77b906f798638962184907d77437e66ef4ba96.gif

Upcoming Updates to the Training System
1. The existing training system is currently in its BETA version, undergoing
refinement and enhancement.
2. Presently, the system exclusively supports 1:1 gameplay.
3. Future updates will introduce support for expanded gameplay options,
including up to 3:3 matches.
4. Ongoing updates are scheduled to improve the overall user experience,
streamlining both the creation and execution of training sessions.

Reminder:
- You can only upload the files you created.
- The use of forbidden words in all posts and comments on
the training system is prohibited
- Sanctions may apply if any violation of the operating policy is found
while using the training system.
- Please use polite and respectful language when using the training system.
- Posts that are abusive, contain small talk, or do not adhere
to guidelines may be deleted from the training system.
- Sanctions may be carried out based on operational policies.
Please use the system carefully.
- For other inquiries, please use the Customer Center 1:1 inquiry.

=================================================

Join us in the Training System Update and unlock your full potential on the court!
Train smarter, play better. See you in the game!

~ Freestyle 2 Team

Our Goal

The continual objective of Freestyle 2's development team is to increase and
enhance the opportunities for players to excel in their designated roles.

By alleviating the pressure on the scorer position and promoting effective
defensive plays for ball handlers, as well as creating diverse rebounding
situations for big men, we wish to encourage everyone to perform their roles to
the best of their abilities and foster the occurrence of various scenarios.

To achieve this objective, our plan involves fine-tuning the game's balance
during the Classic Court Event and subsequently validating these adjustments
through extensive in-game testing.

Ahead of the extensive patch scheduled for July, we are preparing by
pre-adjusting the efficiency of each attribute and resistance values in
March to ensure a smooth transition and avoid any dissonance with the
planned large-scale balance patch. 

Moving forward, we will continue to strive to provide a more enjoyable
gameplay experience by diligently preparing through various balance
adjustments facilitated by the Classic Court.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ec7b9df7e751d858c4a61c47a8a5b32fc48d8a33.png
1. Regular Match Adjustments
- Resistance from defenders against all shots will increase by 6%.
- Shot Trajectory probability will be adjusted.
- Big Man’s shot success rate reduction based on distance will be slightly
increased.
- The criteria for receiving score buffs when experiencing consecutive losses
will be removed.

2. Attribute Adjustments
- Block and Rebound attributes’ effect will be slightly reduced.
- A new feature will be added to the Tussle attribute.
- When resisting against Big Man, get up to 6% (approximately) resistance
based on the difference in Tussle attribute.
(1 Block Resistance difference: 0.11% increase)
 - For the other targets (Scorer, Ball Handler), get up to 5% (approximately)
resistance based on the difference in Tussle Attribute.
(1 Block Resistance difference: 0.025% increase)
 - Positions aside from Big Man (C, PF, CT) will not have their Move Speed
attribute affect their Box Out Speed.
 - Big Man (C, PF, CT)’s Tussle attribute will increase their Box Out Speed.

3. Addressing the Issue: Blocking Player Movement
- You will fall over when making contact with an opposing character while
using the Pick and Move skill.
- Using dash to push away an opponent will reduce your stamina by 70%.
- You cannot use dash to push away an opponent if you have less than 70%
stamina.
(The dev team will monitor the game to check if this change can be abused
by attackers)

4. Skill Adjustments
- The Perfect Pass skill for the PG position will be removed.
- Your stamina will not recover for 2 seconds after using the Away Screen
Move skill.

5. Specialty Skill Adjustments
- Fake Shot Steal’s success rate increase specialty skill will be slightly buffed. 
- Upon using the Hook Hook Defense specialty skill, Ankle Break will not
apply for Fake Shot Drive.
- Hook Shot & Skyhook Shot Range Increase specialty skill’s maximum distance
will be reduced.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c634f25e3e9e06e91bbc10514a077412f3be734f.png

Big Man (C, PF, CT).
- ‘Jab Step and Shoot Delay’ +1 will be added to SG Position’s majesty skill.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d809fa8379460348881a6fc18599f2a50d0c0a9c.png

We're excited to unveil the latest February update, packed with exciting 
improvements and features to enhance your gaming experience like never 
before!

This February update is our way of showing our commitment to continuously 
improving Freestyle 2 and delivering the best possible gaming experience to our 
dedicated community.

What's Included in the February Update:

1. Set Accessories

Equip all set items of accessories, and unlock a whole new level of power!
Experience the thrill of gaining additional attributes when you complete your
accessory sets. 

Accessory Preview:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/726b7ba55ab5f6a595f429483918ea7590ffca1b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/01a077fcf56785911492c8926c74e523e5734f1c.png

Hidden Outfit Effect Details:
 
What is an Outfit Set?
1.  Outfit Sets are divided into "Transformation Sets" and "Attribute Sets".
2. You get an effect by equipping all pieces of the set.
- Transformation Outfit Set: When the match starts, the outfit changes according
to the time.
- Attribute Outfit Set: Permanently gain the Attribute bonuses given by the set.
 
Outfit Set Feature Description:
 
- Transformation Set Outfit Function:
 
1. Outfit change every 30 seconds after the match starts.
2. Outfit changes occur every time turns change between OFF/DEF.
3. Transformation characters change after their transformation is over and outfit
changes are applied only to the main character for switching characters.
4. If they have Back Acc, the Back Acc Ceremony will be unusable.
 
- Attribute Set Outfit Function:
 
1. When outfitted, the ability value always increases.
2. This is applied to the "Switching char" wearing the outfit set.

2. Character Note

We are introducing a brand-new Character Note function that adds a personal
touch to your gaming journey. 
 
Located in the character lobby, this feature allows you to see the details about
your Characters Attributes, Card, Action, and Records information.

It's important to note that only the user can view their own
attributes.

notes.title: January 1st Balance Patch and Improvements
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/780d763c3ce12b57096fe7e294076baf58bc1d27.png

We are delighted to bring you an array of awesome updates and improvements
to elevate your Freestyle 2 experience! 

Our development team has been hard at work crafting features, refining
gameplay, and incorporating your valuable feedback to ensure that
Freestyle 2 continues to be the ultimate destination for our Ballers!

We are excited to share these latest advancements with you, promising
more excitement, smoother gameplay, and a host of new features to
explore!

1. 1/10 (wed) Balance Contents Update
We aim to enhance the game's content and introduce diverse features
for a more immersive user experience

2. 1/17 (Wed) Play Balance Update
We have planned several key updates, including adjustments to play
balance, equipment content, and the removal of the street block.

In 2024, we acknowledge the importance of play balance and are
committed to enhancing the gaming experience by replacing the
long-standing 'street block' system with new, regularly updated
equipment content. This change will be aligned with the evolving
play meta, and we will consider both external and achievement factors.

Our goal is to significantly improve player satisfaction.

For more details, please refer to the information provided below.
We highly encourage you to share your feedback on the balance patch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3ce8e18af6931eae688e1e7ec50753c0a2124006.gif

1. Loading Page Improvements

- During the matching process, we improved the area where the
'loading' indicator obscured the position and Mastery
- Pre-season Ranking grade display changed from Master grade
or higher to Platinum Tier 3 grade or higher.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/24be958deecd7fa4d2885e39c25b2a0b9b215284.png

2 Crew Entrance Scene Added

- the entrance scene and map will change for Crew matches.

3 Win Streak Display Changes

- When a character is on a win streak, the color of the displayed
nickname will change.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6b31c58ee69b95bc0fde100f4311bbae53b9b61a.png

4. MVP Scene Changes

- Additional types of MVP scenes have been added and will be
played based on probability.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1ad6de5004e0bdc398f636c26d58dbc4882f0bd6.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a4fcab2315cca43413515763567d26668a3b40ea.gif

5. Match Result Page Changes

- the match results page displays new match records and season
records.
- the MVP user display is enhanced.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a4694b3b1e05f3904c5ba0ea4e593029d7ad9a59.gif

6.  Removal of match waiting rewards

- The reward paid in the gift box while waiting for matching
has been removed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ffcfc94bd5d87eced0134f0bb929071cb27c847a.gif

1.  Ranking Page Improvements

(1) Ranked Game Improvements
- In 2024, the beta season will end and a new season will begin.
- The ranked game image has been changed.

(2) LOS Ranked Game Store Outfit Added
- The “White Ribbon Outfit Set” will be added to the LOS Ranked Game Shop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b9207908d2a01bacf9245f58cf92b5662d61f75d.gif

Oufit Preview:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d0cbacb37cd2d10963bd6f5c94bf9ccff34d016b.gif

(3) Change the pre-rank calculation formula
- The reset score before the ranking was adjusted to alleviate the problem of
reaching a high grade with a small number of matches.

2. Ranking

(a) Ranked Game Tab
- The “Top League” tab will change to the “TOP 300” tab, and “Master,”
“Diamond,” and “Platinum” tabs will be added.
- the “Promising Star” tab will be removed.
- a “Detailed Record Help” button will be added.

(b) Rating Ranking Tab
- the rating Ranking tab will be removed.

(c) Crew Ranking Tab
- Crew Ranking calculation method will be changed.
-Crew ranking points are allocated based on the ranks of the characters in
each crew.
-The ranking is determined by the crew that accumulates the highest score

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b9324555001cecea9e28f930318faf9f88e8c3de.png

(d) Changed Ranked game Page
- Changes to the Ranked Matches page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8f001a8b13c3cd54bae2035f9365adb456466172.gif

(1) Broadcast Car UI Improvements
- the position of the Broadcast Car camera UI button in the Lobby screen will
be changed, a broadcasting preview area will be added, and the current number
of ongoing broadcasts will be displayed.
- Different colors will indicate Different types of Broadcast Cars.

→ Mid-level competition: Yellow

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e38192e29fead98733d50b70703609e57b7ce2ef.gif
