notes.title: Equipment System Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f9058ea988b5dcd8a18e81e29da4269c8c759836.png

Hey there, ballers! We're thrilled to introduce our brand-new equipment system
to the game. Now, you can gear up with the latest hoops gear to boost your
skills on the court. From high-tech equipments to specialized basketballs,
explore how these new items can enhance up your game and help you
shoot for victory.

Get ready to elevate your basketball experience with our exciting new equipment
lineup!

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/21009bbcb7fded1a184f71865e21d40c7eb79cf0.gif
1. Character Equipment consists of equippable items that do not change
appearance.
2. There is Equipment for 4 parts, and each part can have a max of 4 items
equipped.
3. Each Equipment has unique activation conditions, and if you meet these
conditions while in the match, you will gain Attributes. 
(However, Equipment with the same conditions cannot be simultaneously
equipped or stack)
4. Obtain Attributes have a certain duration, which is determined by the
Equipment grade and quality.
5. All Equipment can be upgraded and disassembled, and successful upgrades
will increase attributes.
6. Disassemlbing Equipment will grant "Equipment Disassembly Pieces", which
can be collected and exchange for higher-grade Equipment and other items. 

Where can you find the Equipment System?
- You can access the new Equipment System by navigating to the Locker tab
at the bottom of your screen and toggling the cursor.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7066bfa592823f306b3407154c78facf7e72cffb.png
How to gear up your new equipment items?
- Navigate to your Equipment Tab/Screen, choose the item, and then click the
check button.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d1bd84b275e0bcee1ea5cd9f9e09ece2c528067a.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cc9ae02d382cd38b3cd09ca584c065ab9c2bae01.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/af3dbf369103ff1c09f0591658ad626ea70f12d1.gif
How to upgrade your equipment items?
- Navigate to your Equipment Tab/Screen, access 'Manage Equipment,'
choose the item you wish to upgrade, and then click on the upgrade button.
(Ensure that you unequip the unlocked equipment item before upgrading it)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d1bd84b275e0bcee1ea5cd9f9e09ece2c528067a.gif
1. All Equipment can be upgraded and disassembled, and successful upgrades
will increase Attributes.
 
2. When upgrading, the success rate and required upgrade materials
vary depending on the grade and upgrade level.
 
3. Upgrade failures can result in a “big failure,” and in such cases upgrade
level will decrease by 1.
 
4. In the event of upgrade failure, you will receive a certain amount of
upgrade materials back.
 
5. Starting from a certain grade and level, you can use Sub Upgrade Material
and doing so will increase upgrade probability.
 
6. Max applicable quantity of Sub Upgrade Material varies depending on
upgrade grade, and they can be obtained from events and other such means.
 
7. Upgrade Materials and Sub Upgrade Materials used to upgrade are
consumed regardless of whether the upgrade succeeds or fails.
 
Example of Attributes by Equipment Upgrade Level
- 3-Pointer Success Rate Increased
 
What Are Equipment Conditions?
1. Each Equipment has unique activation conditions.
2. Each part has 12 activation conditions.
3. If you meet these conditions for equipped Equipment during a game,
you will gain Attributes.
4. If there are 2 or more identical conditions when equipping Equipment,
they cannot be equipped.
 
Equipment Activation Conditions

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0a7364aa102b15f249084ed38cd3273565401f38.png
About Equipment Attributes
"1. Each Equipment has different available Attributes depending on the part.
2. Upon obtaining Equipment, random Attributes will be obtained.
3. Equipment Attributes vary depending on the Equipment Grade and upgrade level.
Note: Applied Attributes are rounded to the nearest whole number.
(Example: +1.6 → +1)"

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b08b029c520e7913b7bebc49051a936961d9a271.gif
About Quality
1. There are 5 grades of Quality for Equipment.
(Lowest/Low/Intermediate/High/Highest)
2. Random quality grades are assigned when obtaining Equipment.
3. The duration of the Equipment condition activation varies depending on quality.
4. Different durations can be obtained even for equipment of the same quality.
 (Detailed obtainable ranges can be checked in the table below.)
5. Quality can be changed using “Equipment Quality Changers.”
6. “Equipment Quality Changers” can be obtained from events
and the Equipment Shop."
 
Condition Duration
Note: Duration based on quality is randomly obtained when obtaining Equipment.
1-1.1 second(s)
 
- When your team scores
- When opponent team scores
- Every even score of your team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ba65b29c2bb39a4f23a6add095ea36604c878f0d.gif
1. You can change equipment quality using Equipment Quality Changers.
2. The quality will be randomly changed among 5 grades: Highest, High,
Intermediate, Low, and Lowest.
3. Quality Changers can be obtained through the "Equipment Shop" or events.
4. 1 Resource will be consumed when changing quality, and
quality changes cannot be canceled.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/66c3ca77e8de990faf60e5cc3734c2e035404a4b.gif
- The disassemble feature will provide you disassembly piece. Disassembly piece
can be used as currency to purchase items from the Material Shop. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c81fed560d461c55126284d25f076460ebba3808.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/41541e4db97c0e9e60890a87d7f6f1932ddeb04f.gif
- You can purchase various items from the Material Shop to purchase
equipment items. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b0a5ace7356b39c8fad2e3e7d8aa38458c524afc.gif
 
Note:
Exchanged items are sent to the Gift Box.

What are you waiting for? Claim your free Equipment Items now!
 
- Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: Upgraded Motion Selection Box Changes
notes.notes:
Greetings Ballers,

We hope you're enjoying the November Festival Event. We would like to address an issue related to the Upgraded Motion Selection Box obtained from this event.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/32fb7671436b84ef5c64849af89f60ebc4eb7302.png

We have noticed that this selection box is currently unable to be used on certain characters who were not originally mentioned.

According to the Event's mechanics, the item can only be used on the Parts Character below:

Saru, Mika, Fei, Deacon, Big Dog, Nadia, Camilla, Alice F, Noah, Yoshi, and Helena

To resolve this issue and ensure that all our players can fully enjoy the benefits of the Upgraded Motion Selection Box, we will be making necessary changes to its item data during the next week's scheduled maintenance.

Here's what you can expect:
- Players are advised to keep the Upgraded Motion Selection Box in their inventory until the maintenance is complete. 
- When you open the Upgraded Motion Selection Box after the maintenance, the contents will automatically be moved to your gift box.
- You will then have the opportunity to select a character from the eligible list as intended.

We understand the inconvenience this issue may have caused, and we sincerely appreciate your understanding and patience as we work to rectify it. 

Thank you for being a part of the Freestyle 2 community.

- Freestyle2 Team

notes.title: Hidden Outfit Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/18034ca7569bcce5866decf447c115d2596937fa.png

[Hidden Outfit]
	
1. A Hidden Outfit is a special outfit that activates unique effects when you wear
all the designated outfits as Hidden Outfits.		

2. Wearing all Hidden Outfits and participating in a match will activate a special
effect. The effect will reset at the end of the match.	

3. Outfits that do not match your gender cannot be worn.
You can check them in the locker.		

- This special outfit has an ‘evolution’ effect where the appearance changes
when you wear all Hidden Outfits and participate in a match.	

- After the match starts, the outfit evolves every 30 seconds progressing
through a total of 3 evolution stages.	

- The outfit will no longer change once the 3rd evolution stage is reached
and will change back to the 1st stage outfit when the match ends.	

- The outfit evolution only occurs during a ‘turnover’ where the offense and
defense switch and it progresses automatically without any manual
intervention.			

*** For characters with transformations, the evolution process will begin with the next ‘turnover’
after their transformation has ended.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/734c382b47a3c7fd8e1c94a96423205f37f077d5.gif

[Set Outfit Evolution Activation Condition]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/426a396aebbcfb4f09812133f52d21bd8d2f665b.png

4) Exceptions
(a) a transformed character
- Time elapses even in transformation.
- The costume evolution will not proceed when the transformation is carried out,
and the costume evolution will proceed when the transformation is released.
 
(b) Switching characters
- When creating a character, only the selected main character can be changed.
 
*** Hidden outfit – cannot equip back accessories ***

- Freestyle 2 Team

- Lettering Items are shared within the account, and you can have up to 999,999,999.

How to Apply Lettering

Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.
* View options can be changed to show only the outfits without the character.
 
1. Lettering Settings
- You can use English, Korean, and Chinese characters as well as numbers for
   lettering.
- Special characters and spaces cannot be used.
* You can enter up to 12 characters.
* Banned words or names of the lettering outfits themselves cannot be used.
 
2. Color Settings
- You can select one of the displayed colors.
 
3. Lettering Trial
- Hover the mouse over a lettering outfit to see the lettering trial button.
- Press the button to try the lettering function.

How to Apply Lettering

Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.
* View options can be changed to show only the outfits without the character.
 
1. Lettering Settings
- You can use English, Korean, and Chinese characters as well as numbers for lettering.
- Special characters and spaces cannot be used.
* You can enter up to 12 characters.
* Banned words or names of the lettering outfits themselves cannot be used.
 
2. Color Settings
- You can select one of the displayed colors.
 
3. Lettering Trial
- Hover mouse over a lettering outfit to see the lettering trial button.
- Press the button to try the lettering function.

notes.title: Crew System Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0d336c85208d0b454926731c9a773bb69112f7bf.png

We are excited to announce the Crew System renewal, improvements, and updates!
For this notice, we will provide you with important notes and information to get you
started!

For more detailed guide of the UI changes and functions, please visit our
Freestyle 2 Guides section for the FreeStyle 2 Crew System Update

Crew Update

1. With the Crew Update, the first and main Crew Name will be set as the name
of your "main character."

2. Crew Main Page

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d82ecd83fd0a6d004d5a6947ccca21ad67e9a413.png

3. Crew Management

3-1. Crew Manager Settings Page

- Crew positions and titles can be set.

a. Crew Master

- There can only be 1 Crew Master.
- The Crew Master can delegate the crew master position to another member and
appoint a Vice Crew Master and Managers.
- Edit and delete posts from the ‘Crew Notice’ and ‘Crew Sentence Board’.
- Accept crew join requests and send out crew invitations.
- Kick crew members from the crew list.
(You cannot kick a member who is in a higher or same position as you)
  (Position Ranking: Crew Master>Vice Crew Master>Manager> Crew)
- Access Crew Quest and Crew Contribution settings.
- Register recruitment posts and access Crew Mark settings.
- Purchase Crew Buffs.

b. Vice Crew Master

- There can only be 1 Vice Crew Master.
- Vice Crew Master can appoint new Managers.
- Edit and delete posts from the ‘Crew Notice’ and ‘Crew Sentence Board’.
- Accept crew join requests and send out crew invitations.
- Kick crew members from the crew list.
(You cannot kick a member who is in a higher or same position as you)
  (Position Ranking: Crew Master>Vice Crew Master>Manager> Crew)
- Access Crew Quest and Crew Contribution settings.
- Register recruitment posts and access Crew Mark settings.
- Purchase Crew Buffs.
* The Vice Crew Master’s authority over the crew can only be edited by the
Crew Master.
* However, during the Vice Crew Master will play the same role as the
Crew Master during the crew stabilization period (2 months).

c. Manager
 
- There can be up to 3 Managers. 
- Accept crew join requests and send out crew invitations.
- Kick crew members from the crew list.
(You cannot kick a member who is in a higher or same position as you)
  (Position Ranking: Crew Master>Vice Crew Master>Manager> Crew)
- Edit and delete posts from the ‘Crew Sentence Board’.
* The Manager’s authority over the crew can only be edited by the Crew Master
and Vice Crew Master.

3-2. Crew Recruitment Management

a.  List of Crew Applications

- The date of which the application was sent, the character name of the sender,
and his or her message will be displayed.
- You can turn on/off open recruitment for the crew with the [Recruit Crew Member] button.
- You can send a crew invitation message with the [Crew Invite] button.
* When sending a crew invitation message, the crew’s crew master’s main
character name will be shown on the message.

3-3. Crew List & Crew Mark

a. Crew List

- You can sort the list in the order of: crew creation (oldest, newest) and
by crew size.
- You can enter and search for any specific crew.
* The crew name must be entered exactly to search.
 
b. Crew Mark

- The Crew emblem is the symbol of the Crew. It is used in the Crew Page.
- You can select the emblem’s layout, design, and color.
- You can access the Crew Mark settings through [Crew Management] >
[Crew Mark].
* Only the Crew Master has access to the Crew Mark.

3-4. Inactive Crew Master Position Delegation

a. Crew Master Position Auto Delegation

- If the Crew Master does not log in for 30 days, the Vice Crew Master
will automatically become the new Crew Master.
 
* If there is no Vice Crew Master, the Manager with the highest total contribution
will become the new Crew Master.
* If there is no Vice Crew Master or Managers, the crew member with the highest
total contribution will become the new Crew Master.
* If everyone’s contribution is the same, the crew member with the oldest account
will become the new crew master.

4. Crew Shop

- FreeStyle 2 Team

Greetings Ballers,
 
We are glad to bring you an update on our Matchmaking System!
 
Through our Satisfaction Survey conducted back in December 2022,
our Freestyle 2 Development Team recognized that one of their top priorities
in development is to provide an improved matchmaking system.
 
In order for our players to enjoy Freestyle 2 in an optimized environment in
2023, we have developed a new matchmaking system designed to match
players with ideal and minimal latency between each other. However, with the
new matchmaking system in place, it may require more queuing time than before
to apply this new condition with minimized latency.
 
After the 2 weeks of Beta Testing Period, we will decide on its final implementation
based on user satisfaction.
 
The Freestyle2 developers are always listening to your feedback. Please feel free
to contact us if you have any suggestions for the game.
 
We look forward to your participation.

User Satisfaction Survey Period: March 29th, 2023 - April 4th, 2023

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/04a340976aa39d2f518fddff351683e6800892db.png

Greetings Ballers!

We're down to our last Patch for this year!

Our team have prepared exciting stuff for everyone to enjoy~

Please refer to the details below for our December Improvements:

1. Parts Shop

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/da9b2307067a371b9b436f8bb82870712d8e82a7.gif

Once the 12/14 update has been implemented in-game, all characters
will be able to check the Parts Shop.

In addition, we've converted the Parts price from 1,000
Mileage Points to 1,000 Points!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/22e8dbe6f024f4fcc6714d66925432fdba5f8870.png

Note: Parts will only be available to participating Parts Characters.

2. Locker Improvement

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cc960b5595b7ee01eaadc4d180e83e077e17a05d.gif

Now, users don't have to think what's the main purpose of a particular item from their inventory.

Each item from your inventory will now have a corresponding description.

This would be really helpful and convenient especially for our new and upcoming players!

- Outfit-related items: Info on required level is deleted and item description is added.
- Custom Ball items: Info on required level is deleted and item description is added.
- All other items: Info on required level is deleted, item description is added, and
stat/effect/ceremony effect is added.

3. Gift Box Improvement

- Hovering your mouse to a particular package item will now give you a preview of its content
- Hovering your mouse to a selection box item now gives you a preview of its content

notes.title: Draft System Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/574e526da0ef22ade77d8b4278e837e5cfe61679.png

Here comes a better twist for our Draft System!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/11d96c9275566f9de6d951e118447d1aa78de105.png

How to Participate
 
Step.1: Once Draft Season is running, players can participate in the Draft event by
choosing one of the Draft Characters or player's originally owned characters.
 
- At the end of the Draft Season, the new season will be a fresh start after the end period. (View Results)										
- Characters in the character growth mode can also participate.											
- If you participate in the draft with an existing character, you cannot receive STEP level compensation.	

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/62de8cc825e9ae3bb705ca7267b9b4639576392f.png

Step.2:  Increase the STEP level through daily, weekly, and season quests during the season.			
			
Step Level:
		
- You can increase the STEP level with the experience you gain while participating in the draft and completing the quest.			
- At the end of the draft season, the available rewards vary depending on the STEP level.			
			
STEP Level Up Ticket	


- Not available using points

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b4ea5c0493a1395602dfaad500136404fe141339.png

Draft Pass Ticket	



- Available using points

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b4ea5c0493a1395602dfaad500136404fe141339.png

Result Reward Changer	



- Available using points								
- Once user reached Lv.6, User can obtain character randomly, by buying this result reward changer user can draw the character once again		

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/15e05b9d288fb48736362f10d5afc3b476a8c5a8.png

Details		

- Quest has different attainable experience values by difficulty level.											
- The same mission cannot be duplicated.											
- Weekly quests are initialized every Monday at 00:00.											
- If you use the draft pass ticket item, you can proceed with the season quest. (Applies immediately when purchasing draft pass ticket items.)											
- Draft result rewards are only available for the end (View Results) period.											
- Draft compensation will be paid to the locker room.											
- Transformation and parts characters will be paid with all of their abilities or items in possession. (However, Draft Golden, Violet, Cabernet, Nari, and Alazak will be paid with only parts without transformation.)											
- All character compensation will be paid with a change ticket, and characters will be randomly changed among characters that can be obtained by step level when using the change ticket.											
- You can raise the STEP level by 1 when using the SETP Level Up Ticket item. (The experience value becomes 0 when using the SETEP Level Up privilege.)											

- FreeStyle2 Team

1. Weekly Ranking Event runs 7 days a week for 3 Weeks.
2. Users who wish to participate need to complete at least 3 matches per day to be part of the ranking process
3. Weekly Ranking rewards will be sent to your Character's inventory at the end of each week
4. Weekly Ranking Event is a newly-released player ranking Event in which a different type of ELO rating
is being recorded into the account. (Event ELO resets every week)
5. The Weekly Ranking Event lasts for 3 Weeks and a Champion's League will be held in Week 4

7. The Top 10 users (Overall, not per position) for each week will be qualified for the Champion’s League
8. Users registered in the ranking can be selected as rivals. When a rival is chosen, the rival’s current ranking can be checked in the waiting room.
9. Participation in the Weekly Ranking Event cannot be canceled and you will have to participate every week

2. Only the Top 10 users who played well in the past three weeks in the Weekly Ranking Event will be qualified to enter the Champion’s League.
3. When the Champion’s League starts, the Top 10 players from Week 1 to 3 will be transferred to the league automatically.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b49ddb08f6436f687cc02582a8d51a566db58bc2.png

Hello, This is Freestyle 2 Developer.
 
A week has passed since our July Balance Patch.
We have gathered the Play Data for each Position 
and reviewed the parts that we can improve.
 
We have prepared a 1st HotFix for the Balance Patch
on our 7/28 Weekly Maintenance.
 
Please check the details below to avoid any difficulties in playing the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/26860cd17c4b9e1c01010866d649063047123946.png

Today’s Hotfix will be mainly based on the improvements for the SG Position.
 
We will make the improvements to create a more Inside Drive-in and
outside play rather than a previous playstyle.
 
In addition, to make our patch more stabilized, we will continue to improve
our balance through HotFix.

Therefore, please give us various feedbacks for our balance patch.

Please note that the masteries for SG/SF Positions will be reset after the HotFix patch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3ab7506fc4d735df29abbd306cc648e66f0fd294.png

1. BackRoll Turn Master Logic improvements 
 
A. In case of Back Roll Turn Master Timing Fake, if the opponent is half marked, Max 5% Increase 
B. In the case of Back Roll Turn Master Ankle Break, if a shot is released Defense resistance hugely decreased
  - In a case when the defender gets an Ankle break in front of the offender, the phenomenon that
the resistance is still applied has been fixed.
 
2. Swing&Swing Mastery Improvements
A. Mastery Level 1, Long Layup: range↑ +8 Added in default
 - Mastery Level 3, Long Layup: range↑ +8 Removed
 
B. Mastery Level 5, in Floater Success Rate ↑ Skill, Long Layup: range↑ +4 Added 
 
C. Mastery Level 5, Spin and Drive Skill Added
D. Mid shot Strengthened
 - Midshot has been decreased and Mid shot related Stats have been adjusted in the Drift Mastery Skill 
E. Mastery Level 7, Drift Pass & Run Skill, Moving Speed increase after Drift Pass 20 Added. 

3. Short Intercept Mastery Skill Stat Improved 
 
A. Steal +4 -> +10
B. Pass +4 -> +15

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2c715290938b6d7557f04d729c07ad14e6cd248d.png

1. Post-Up Jumper Mastery Improvements

 A. Mastery Level 7, Drive-in Dribble Master Skill, Drive: speed↑ +2
 B. All skills in Mastery Level 10, that had Move: speed↑ Adjusted.
   - Move: speed↑ 4 ? 5 
C. Mastery Level 10, Double Clutch Fade Away Skill, Move: speed↑ 5 Added 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f1ee4b219a3dc313861181a1ad14fea76a3471c4.png

1. Hesitation Mastery Improvements

A. Mastery Level 5, Skill Improvements 
 - Stamina Consumption Approximately 40% Reduced 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/48e07754ae37475d1236a99ba33d254f22a11e9a.png

1. Pass & run Skill Downgrade

- Stamina Consumption increased

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/29cb752b7702ead9ee4a8211f458da5a45364e98.png

1. Quick Rob Catcher Mastery

- Mastery Level 10, Long Dunk Manual Block Master, 
Long Dunk Manual Block Range Increase +33 Added

This is the end of our details in our 1st HotFix for our Balance Patch
 
We will keep getting more suggestions from our users and
review our data more to balance the positions.
 
However, our ballers need to get more used to the 1st Balance Patch
and since the related play data should be accumulated enough
for our developing team to review and make better directions,
please understand that we would need some time.
 
Please give your suggestions to our support team.
 
We always thank you

- Freestyle 2 Development Team

Nari is a 15 year-old middle school student. Nari is a bright student. but something about her is different from that of her schoolmates.
 
Athletically, she is exceptionally gifted. And every week, she prays ~ very sincerely ~ to the GOd that her family servers.
 
Using the power given by God, Nari is able to perform outstanding abilities that are incredible for her age.
However, Nari does not overuse or abuse the powers given to her. It's because of the powers that she harnesses were given to her to fulfill the duties of God. But of course, she didn't realize this until recently.
 
One day, while she was praying. Nari found the "Damaged Sacred Text" at the altar by coincidence. 
 
'FreeStyle 2 Competition Team Savior ...' Due to the intense erosion that the book has suffered over the

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d716ad2b710acc5383c6d4a0d9323caf38737b84.png

Mega Pass is back! Complete all the levels and acquire this season's exclusive Cosmetic Items as well as other goodies!
 
Sale Period:

01/27 00:00 - 03/23 23:59 (PST)
 
Event Details:

Players can be rewarded by leveling the tier up! Play games and finish up challenges to collect stars to level up your Mega Pass. When reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward the hard work of the player. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/83166f03646d3da9dcbe6b89bbffb68cd932b0da.gif

Players can also purchase the Mega pass TierUp! in order to level-up quickly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c5162e5d56f6b3496f30fce3ea0f03d973a88c6b.png

Players can buy the Premium Mega Pass for 990 GKash which will give them access to additional quests and more rewards.
 
Note: Users will not be able to gain any more stars on the last week of the Mega Pass.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/65f2f239b74ff15a863f917aa4d78f02e7c4f870.jpg

The Mega Pass contains Tiers for levels. 
 
Every tier there will be a reward for both a regular and a Premium Mega Pass. 
 
How do I Level Up my Mega Pass?
 
You can level up your Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars. 
 
Stars can be acquired by completing daily and weekly quests, and by completing the Pass Grade Missions.

Hello This is Freestyle 2 Developer.
 
Please check the following balance and bug fix that will be applied to the game after the
 7/29 maintenance.

Balance Fix

1. Range increased when PG’s Face Up Dash is used after using Free Action Bug has
 been fixed.

2. Improved PG's collision motion not to be applied during “Full Speed” preparation time.
 
3. When the Last Resistance was successful by the defender, Shot Resistance applied to
 Put Back Dunk or a Tip In Shot for bounced ball bug has been fixed.

4. Condition for activating Last Resistance when a team defender is standing under 
the rim has been removed (Unable to activate even if your teammate is under the rim)

5. Last Resistance’s Under the rim Condition before 7/22 Patch has been applied 
- We have removed the condition since there was a bigger influence to Swing Strategy 
than the positive aspects of defending ISOs. We will keep on monitoring the 
Swing Strategy and improve it. 

Bug Fix

1. Start Up Dash Enhancing Pack Bug Fix
A. Missions not being updated when the possessing number of Enhancing Chip is 
0 has been fixed (Did not have issues when you had 1 or more enhancing chips)

B. The number of Enhancing Chips that weren’t applied will be applied during 
the maintenance.

notes.title: [Freestyle 2 Developer’s Note] July 2020 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6d3b9ac5a076d85b17378b3720cc9f20f9587a14.png

Hello, this is Freestyle 2’s developer.

In this balance patch, we have prepared a patch to improve the defensive efficiency of the 3pt play against the iso tactics (including PF ISO), and in certain situations.

There was also an improvement in Pillar tactics last April, and we're trying to adjust this patch to make it more efficient.

A. New Mastery Skills and Updates

1. Long Dunk Manual Block Master
- Skill description: Long dunk block range rise during manual block (except freestyle dunk and short dunk)

- Mastery Attributes

1. Center

 Added to Shadow Rim Protector Lv5
 Increased Long dunk manual block Range 30
 Power rebound range reduction 6


2. Power forward

 Added to Energy Rim Protector Lv5
 Increased long dunk manual block Range 30
 Decreased Mid. shot success rate 3


3. Control Tower

 Added to Quick Lob Catcher Lv7
 Increased long dunk manual block range 30
 Block attribute 4


- Others
1. For manual long dunks only
2. Not applicable to freestyle dunks.

2. Dunk Shot Resist Master
- Skill description: The higher the tussle ability, the greater the resistance to dunk shots.
  
- Mastery Attributes

1. Center

 Added to Heavy Rob Catcher Lv10
 Power Rebound Range 3


2. Power Forward

 Added to Energy Lob Catcher attribute Lv7
 Short Dunk: success%↑ 4
 Long Dunk: success%↑ 4


3. Control Tower

 Added to Option Man Lv10
 Stamina +3


- Others
1. Excludes when defender is on stand (applicable only when defender is in block status)
2. Resistance applies to all dunk types

3. Strengthened Last Resistance
- Skill description: Even attackers with high tussle can be given resistance with a certain probability depending on the altitude of ball possession. (However, the resistance probability depends on the attacker's ball possession time.)
 
- Mastery Attributes

1. Center

 Added to Heavy Rob Catcher Lv7
 Last-resistance activation rate increased 5
 Shadow block Horizontal Range -3


2. Power forward

 Added to Energy Lob catcher Lv10
 Last-resistance activation rate increased 5
 Mid.shot : success%↓  3


3. Control Tower

 Added to Option Man Lv5
 Last-resistance activation rate increased 5
 Block Attribute +2


- Others
1. Activates in probability according to the ball possession time regardless of dunk/layup to the attacker who has tussle exceeding 190 (defenders can resist if the attacker owned the ball for more than 2 seconds) 

4. Shot fake Steal Success Rate Increased
- Skill description: If equipped, Steal range increases for Shot Fake and steal success rate increases for 3pt Shot Fake and Jab Step. (However, in case of Jabstep, steal success rate depends on the ball possession time.)

- Mastery Attributes

1. Point Guard

 Added to Quickstep Chaser Lv5
 Manual block:range -6


2. Dual Guard

 Added to Defensive Style Lv5
 3pt Attribute -3


- Others
1. Steal Success Rate Increase for 2pt shot fake is not applicable.

5. Hun Hun Defense
- Skill description: After a certain time, Hun-hun Defense activates, where the character spreads out his or her arms to interrupt the opponent’s shots. (However, if you fail Drive Defense, you reveal a large opening)

- Mastery Attributes

1. Point Guard

 Added to Atheletic Outlier Lv5
 Steal Motion Speed -2


- Others
1. Hun-Hun defense only activates in stand-up situations when continuing for a certain period of time. (Shot resistance is not allowed when moving)
2. When Hun-hun defense is activated, the attacker's timing-fake shot defense resistance is greatly reduced.
3. When Hun-hun defense is activated, a shot resistance with a level slightly higher than the normal stand resistance is applied.
4. When shot deny status (with the R key held), 100% angle brake is applied to drive-in dribbles. 

6. Tip in shot, Put Back dunk success rate increased
- Skill description: When equipped, increases the success rate of tip in shot and put back dunk.

- Mastery Attribute (a combined version mastery skill of Tip In Shot and Put Back Dunk that were previously separated)

1. Center

  Added to Heavy Rob Catcher Lv7
  Tip In shot: success% +10
  Put back Dunk: success% +10
  Shadow Block Horizontal Range -3


2. Power forward

 Added to Energy Lob Catcher Lv7
 Tip In shot: success% +10
 Put back Dunk: success% +10
 Short Dunk: success% +6
 Long Dunk: success% +6


B. Changes

1. PF Changes
- Intention: Since the Long dunk defense difficulty has been lowered, added manual double-clutch dunk, faster spin-move up and Steel Will to be selected at the same time to improve PF attack tactics. Creating a more efficient Pillar Strategy.

- Power Dunker Mastery

1. Double-clutch dunk

 Manual Double Clutch Dunk Available
 skill description Change
 Cheat opponent during layup and dunk one more time. (Can be activated with manual layup)


2. Faster spin move layup

Lv 5 → Lv 7


3. Turning Shot Speed↑

 Lv 7 → Lv 5


4. Beyond Screen Dunk

 Rebound -5 Removed
 Beyond Screen Dunk Block Resistance↑ changed : 20 → 25
 Beyond Screen Double Clutch Dunk Success Rate ↑ +15 Added


- Energy lob catcher Mastery

1. Chip out Enhancement (Lv10)
 
 Chip out Enhancement Mastery Skill Removed


2. Strong Will (Lv10)

 Dunk Blcok Resistance Increased↑:  8 → 15


2. CT Changes

- Option Man Masteries

1. Quick Screen & Dash (Lv5)

 Removed


2. Screen & Dash (Lv5)

 Applied Quick Screen & dash Function 
 skill description changed -	After the screen/quick screen is successful, the movement speed increases


3. Screen Angle Upgrade (Lv10)

 Removed


4. Screen Collisions upgrade (Lv10)

 Screen: Collision angle 12 added (Screen Angle Upgrade function Applied)
 Skill Name Changed -	Screen angle/Collisions upgrade



 Skill description - When equipped, increases the range of screen angle and collision.


3. C Changes

- Low-post playmaker Mastery

1. Screen angle Upgrade (Lv10)
-  Removed

2. Screen Collision Upgrade (Lv10)

 Screen: Collision angle 12 added (Screen Angle Upgrade function Applied)
  Name Changed - Screen angle/crash enhancement
  Skill description changed - When equipped, increases the range of screen angle and collision.

4. DG Changes

- Defensive Style Mastery

1. move collision angle attribute ↑ (Lv5)
- Removed

2. move collision resistance attribute ↑ (Lv5)
move:collision angle↑ +24  Added (move collision angle attribute Function Applied)

 Name Changed - Move collision resistance / Angle attribute↑
 Skill description - When equipped, move collision resistance and angle attributes increase.


5. PG Changes

- Quickstep Chaser Mastery

1. move collision angle attribute ↑ (Lv5)
- Removed

2. move collision resistance attribute ↑ (Lv5)

 move:collision angle↑ +24  Added (move collision angle attribute Function Applied)
 Name Changed: Move collision resistance / Angle attribute↑	
 Skill description Changed: When equipped, move collision resistance and angle attributes increase.	


6. Common Changes
- Last resistance Skill Improvements

1. Conditions Changed

 Previous: Activated if there is no attacker under the goal
 Change: Only activates when there are no other opponents except the attacker under the goal (activates even if there is a defender from the same team).


2. Last Resistance Activation Rate Increase for Layup/dunk shot
- Shot success rate after second Shot Fake Decreased

1. Jump Shot success rate after the 2nd Shot Fake decreased
2. Shot success rate gradually increases after when there are more tries after the 2nd shot fake
- When character has been moved, the no of shot fake resets
3. Not applicable to drift shots.

So these are the adjustments made.
We are constantly monitoring and analyzing your feedback through various channels. We look forward to your continued interest and opinions, and the development team will do our best to listen to the feedbacks.

Thank you.

notes.title: 04/08 Balance Patch Hot Fix
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1510635d609bfa463c9c065d07ed0478757cde07.png

Hello This is Freestyle 2 Developer.

After the balance patch, we have been checking the areas that were difficult to adapt to, and we're going to put a hotfix by organizing the areas that need to be complemented.

PF 

1. Last Resistance set as F Key 

2. Beyond Screen Dunk
(1) Screen Mid Shot Resistance Decrease added
(2) Dunk Block Resistance Rate 15 -> 20

**We will be consistently adjusting the parts that could give adequate balance for Pillar Strategy. 

SG
1. Back Roll Turn Master Ankle Break Relieved 

(1) When defender is standing, Ankle break Check Range shortened 
-> Activates Ankle Break when Defender’s Standing status is within a certain range.

(2) Ankle Break Activation Rate Lowered corresponding to the distance with the defender

**When Ankle breaks with Back Roll Turn Master Mastery’s Back Roll turn Speed and Timing Fake, majority of users have faced difficulties in defending, more than expected rate. 

Therefore, we have adjusted the Ankle Break to relieve the defending difficulties, we will consistently review the Swing SG Plays in the top tiers and adjust it to create a better efficiency. 


SF 
1. Technical Shot Master
(1) When used with Drift Shot, Speed Increased 3 -> 5

2. Drift Shot Speed Upgrade
(1) Drift Shot Motion Speed 7 -> 5

3. Drift Shot Release Point Upgrade
(2) Drift Shot Release Point 10 -> 7

**We have progressed an adjustment to the Drift Shot Upgrade Mastery like the SG’s Back Roll Turn Mastery since there were higher effectiveness to the offense than intended. 

DG

1. Athletic Style Mastery Adjustment 
(1) Lv7 Baseball Pass
- Block +4 -> Block -4 (Changed)
- Pass +10 (Added)

2. Drive in Jumper
(1) Shot Release Point Increase

**High Block Mastery of DG as a Ball Handler Roll style is still having a greater effectiveness than intended. Therefore, to run a Ball Handler Roll we have added Pass Att to increase the pass play style, however, decreased the block effectiveness when selecting Baseball Pass. In addition, to give more diverse selection in offense, we have increased the release point for Drive In Jumper. 

PG
1. Perfect Pass
 (1) When Perfect Pass succeeds, Block Resistance ↑ Increased 

**We have increased the effectiveness of Perfect Pass for PG. 
The development team will continue to analyze the user’s play and improve it according to the direction as much as possible. Thank you very much

notes.title: [Freestyle 2 Developer’s Note] December Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/810b8c4f9e35997b998455b9fa3b7d9d01d4caaf.png

Hello
This is Freestyle 2 Developer.

We only have a few days of the year 2019. How was your 2019?
We had various changes and updates to our Freestyle 2. We would like to end our 2019 with the following contents below.

1. Balance Hot Fix
First, we have progressed a balance hot fix. Improved the problems that needed to be filled out made in our last Balance Patch. We will continuously reflect the things in order to bring out more fun game plays.

A.	Center
1) Shadow Block Catch Success Rate Decreased
2) Shadow Block Dunk Success Rate slightly decreases

B.	Shooting Guard
1) Side hop step Mastery Changes
a) Side Hop Step Motion Speed Increased (Motion Speed -24 -> -12)

C.	Small Forward
1) Technical Shot Master Feature Added
a) When drift shot is used, Shot Speed slightly increases
(not applied in pivot)

2. Card Stress Relief #3
A #3 Update has been made that we have been progressing starting from our October Patch.
In our 3rd update, the previous pkgs will be continuously given. Additionally, we have released a Card Sub Att item that can lock one of your sub attributes during the time when sub attribute changer is used. The Item Is exclusive for Allstar World Cards, therefore please have a look and enjoy.

3. Mentoring Day Event Released
We have prepared a mentoring day event to make our New and Starting users to adapt to our FS2 Game easily. Please check out the event details in our game or in our event post.

4. Crew Updates
A few features have been improved in our Crew Features. Various features and responsibilities have been added in Crew Management, please enjoy the crew system. We do know that this update also may be not enough; we will continuously improve our crew system.

5. Feedbacks Applied
Recently and also in an everyday basis, we have been gathering up various feedback from lots of routes including Facebook, Website tickets, steam email support, etc.
We were able to update daily quest rewards, item exchange from stacked up card upgrade spray, increased the number of user blocks, Delete Feature of items in the locker room, Replay Improvements. Please give us more various feedbacks that has given you difficulties. We will continue to listen to our users’ feedback and prepare an update for those.

Merry Christmas and we wish you have a great New Year in 2020.

Thank you

notes.title: 2019.12.4th Balance Patch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f2dbbc9b8c28e8761acd5d5a0934ce865240ca26.png

Hello!

This is the Freestyle 2 Developer.

How are you guys doing? The Winter Season has arrived! And our last month of 2019 is here now.

We’ve came up with another Developer’s Note after our previous 10/30 Developer’s note.

Previously, we have indicated a few things about our developing phases and our directions. In this November Patch, the developer’s note will be regarding what we have thought of the changes made by our users from 10/30 patch.

1. Card Stress Relief #2
From our 1st Card Stress Relief (Joycity’s giveaway pkg, char. Creation pkg, and the card upgrade condition removal) on the 10/30, we have decided to give an extension to the events in order to give more users benefits from the card stress relief. A lot of our users loved the 1st Act and we would want to extend the period.

In addition, we have changed our Card Balls’ Card Reward Grades, setting up the Legend Pro cards as the lowest Card grades that you can get in the reward. We’ve also removed the “Enhanced Prism Card” Condition in the main slot at the Card Creation page. This was made to provide easier chances for our users to upgrade their cards to Allstar Pro Cards.

The chances in collecting Card Materials for Card Creation became much easier than before, and the removal of enhanced prism card requirement would relieve card stresses that our users had.

We aren’t stopping here; the Card Stress Relief #3 is indeed scheduled.

2. Ranking
The biggest fun in PVP game would be Ranking, however, our Ranking page wasn’t able to show enough to create fun activities, therefore we have prepared a separate Ranking Contents Page to the UI Menu instead of a small button which was placed next to the character.

Ranking page is divided into 3 pages, the MMR, the Record, and the Crew.

- MMR Ranking: A Rank that shows 100% of the users’ ELO scores.
Previously there was an Added Value Points which made confusion to the Ranking page, therefore we have removed the added value points to show pure rank, based on their proficiency of the game.

- Record Ranking: A Rank that shows the records in the Season.

- Crew Ranking: A Rank that shows crews with rankings based on the crew members’ MMR Ranking.

 Each Ranking Season starts from the 1st day and ends on the last day of the month. The character registers in the Ranking based on 3 Matches played per a day. (the character gets excluded from the Ranking when the character has not played or met the 3 matches / day requirement.

-EX 1) Users should play the following to have their characters registered,
1 Day 3 Matches, 10 Days 30 Matches, 30 Days 90 Matches 

-EX 2) Even if the character does not play after playing 9 matches in the 1st day, the character will still be registered until the 3rd day of the season.

-EX 3) If the character did not play 12 matches or above on the 4th day of the season, the character will be removed from the ranking.

-EX 4) If you have played 90 Matches in 1 Day (just an example) in the 1st week of the month, the ranking will stay even if you did not play until the 30th Day.
The Days will differ in which Month Season you are playing at, for December season, since we have 31 days, the user needs to play 93 matches to be ranked until the last day.

Please read the Help Page in the Ranking for further information.

1. Balance Patch

This balance patch is the basis of Freestyle 2.

The primary goal is to develop an easy-to-follow swing tactical play.

In the future, we will continue to make it easier and more efficient to play.

Based on the balance patch we’ve made, we will improve in a variety of ways to gradually improve the particular positions with low winning rate and population.
To balance the various tactics, we will try not to make nerf patches as much as we can. And solve the problems by buffing alternative and other tactics and adding a number of interactive tactical events.

After the patch, we will gather opinions from the users through various ways and continue to reflect it in the game.

Please support us and give us your opinion.

Thank you.


Detailed Balance Patch

[Mutual changes]

1. All Masteries Level 10 Applied
- When your character level gets up to 24, all masteries will open up to level 10.
- Masteries is one of the biggest impacts to the current Balance, changes were made to have our users experience all masteries.

2. Attacking Time 24 Secs -> 22 Secs
- Reducing the time contains various meanings. A much speedier attacking style, changes to the strategy and method, restraining particular play style, etc will be made by reducing the time.
- However, there will be a huge risk if we reduce with a big amount of time, therefore we will be considering the time adjustments by gathering and reviewing the related data and the style changes made after the patch.

3. Paint Zone Deny Intercept Rate Adjustments 
- By reducing the attacking time, one of the things we were worried about was the Unintentional Nerf to the Swing Strategy. 
 We thought the play must not be stressful and too nervous, but must be speedy and smooth.
- We have first reduced the Deny Intercept Rate in the Paint Zone, to make 2nd attack and return play much easier.

4. Score Buff adjustment
- We have improved the score buffs because we believe buff-related systems for light user care often adversely affected the current play method when the score is higher than a certain point difference.

5. Improved Post-up quick change skill (Timing Reliefs)


[Skill Changes]


1. PF

- Control Improvements, easier attacks are improved for Light users.

A. My way Dunk Focus 1 (Passive) Skill Added
 1) Able to Dunk in a pivot, only Straight front dunks are available (but with lower success rate)

 2) Straight Front dunk activates when F Key is pressed even without an arrow key								
											
B. Dunk Upgrade, Dunk Focus given as basic skills
											
2. C

- We have reduced the applied tussle stats which made Screen Upgrade_2's tussle too aggressive and improved to show the true identity of a "Center"
- To enhance the pass play, we've given kill pass to C and expect the center to be in the central role.

A. Kill Pass Skill Added
1) Kill Pass: speed +12							
										
B. SP Dunk Success% II, Dunk Focus given as Basic Skills			

C. Shadow Block Rate slightly uplifted			
											
D. Shadow Block&Catch I Skill Added				
1) When Shadow Blocks, Shadow Block&Catch Skill activates at a certain rate.
2) When Shadow Block&Catch Skill activates the character grabs the ball.	

E. Mastery Screen2 Upgrade Range reduced
1) If the physical check increases, the increasing range reduces													

3. SF

- Based on the analysis of the overall balance data, we have determined that we need to improve the performance of our current SF.
- We've improved the ability to effective attack in swing strategy.

A. Quick Change 2 Skill Added
1) Quick change is possible in all directions when not moving.
2) Quick change can be activated in 90 degrees to the moving direction while moving
3) Unable to equip Quick Change 2 if Away Screen Move Skill is equipped.

B. SF Technical Shot Master 1 Skill Added
1) Drift shot can be used in a pivot
2) Backward to step, back dribble, Spin and Drive. Drift shot after Two Step and Fade away skill available after Technical Shot Master skill activates.
3) Unable to equip when Away Screen Move Skill is equipped
4) Reduced success rate and defense resistance when fade away skill made after the Technical Shot Master Skill.


4. SG
		
-  Based on the analysis of the overall balance data, we have determined that we need to improve the performance of the SG in Swing Strategy.
-  Improved to efficiently attack while using swing strategy


A. Quick Change 2 Skill Added
1) Quick change is possible in all directions when not moving.
2) Quick change can be activated in 90 degrees to the moving direction while moving
3) Unable to equip Quick Change 2 if Away Screen Move Skill is equipped.												

B. Long Range Skill Given as Basic Skill	
														
C. Tripping Prevention Skill Added 	
1) You may fall when colliding with an opponent character with high tussle stats,											

D. Side Hop Step Mastery Skill Added 																

E. Crazy Step Improvements
1) At certain area if Crazy step is used while Drive Dribble, changed to have Drive Dribble to activate first. 

5. PG 

- PG's position has been reduced in strategic parts.
- We will gradually improve the PG's Balance to melt into various strategies. 

A. No Mark Shot Skill Given										
B. Diving Catch Skill Stat Added										
1) Diving Catch: Fail↓ +12 Added									

6. DG

- Improved the smaller risk in selecting Athletic Style Mastery than other masteries.

A. Added extra points in reducing Still Attributes													
	1) Level 1: Steal -10												
	2) Level 7: Steal -5 -> Steal -7												
	3) Level 10: Steal -6 -> Steal -7												


7. SW 

- Added Risk in Swing Man's Powerful Drive in when used in Strategies other than swing

A. Tripping Prevention Fail Condition Added 
1) Tripping Prevention Failure Rate Added when colliding with a player with high tussle. 

We believe this single patch cannot show the full thoughts of the path we're heading to. However, we would like to show improvements little by little.

There is no answer to the balance,
we will show the changes by opening our ears, considering and reviewing one by one to fulfill our users and provide a fun game play.

[Bug Fix]

SF Dash Rebound inactivated in certain condition is fixed
PF Dash Chip out inactivated in certain condition is fixed
Character’s Speed getting slow after receiving the pass from a situation when pass and still is used simultaneously is fixed.

notes.title: [Freestyle 2 Developer’s Note] October Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/064167171806a41a7c1662a6138a42d868a51f13.png

Greetings Ballers,

This is the Developer of Freestyle 2.

We always thank our users for loving and giving full interests to our Freestyle 2.
All of the members in FS2 Team including our GMs had been putting full effort to bring changes to the game. There were some difficulties such as High Barriers for New users, Card Stress, and Balance issues, which made our game harder to play. Therefore, we would like to make some changes and lessen / remove some of the obstacles.

1. High Entry Barrier Relieved
We added a Play Guide contents that could bring the New, Returning, and Light Users to easily adapt to the game. You can check the Video Motions and Guide Descriptions for Rebound, Block, Shot, Screen etc by clicking on the button shown at the Lobby / Piece&DIY / M.Ball / Locker / Char / and the Waiting Room. (Play guide can be set ON/OFF at the Play Guide Screen)
We will be constantly expanding the Guide System to support users to adapt to the game easily.

2. Card Stress Relief
Card Difference of not being able to reduce the gap had been influencing the Play Balance. This has created a higher entry barrier and made some of the users to stop playing the game. Therefore we will continue to reduce the play balance gap by reducing the stress from creating new card decks.
This patch will be our 1st Card Stress Relief update, giving out [Joycity’s Giveaway Package] and [Character Creation Package] and reduced the Card upgrade conditions. In addition, we have included the Max number of cards that can be disassembled at once from 100 to 500.
The Card Stress Relief 2nd update is scheduled in 2019 and will continue to reduce the stress that our users have.

3. Balance Issue
The change to card difference will bring a different result to the balance, we will constantly check the changed balance results and prepare a Balance Update in November/December 2019 by utilizing various Data Types. Balance Update with more details will be introduced in our next developer’s note. 

FS2 Team is putting effort to bring a new change to our Freestyle 2 where users could play the game based on their controls. We will listen to both good and bad opinions, and ofcourse compliments are always welcome.

We will do our best to make a better Freestyle 2, and make our users to enjoy the game.
Thank you.

notes.title: 2019.06.26th Balance Patch
notes.notes:
Hello Ballers.

This is Freestyle 2 Developer from Joycity.

In our Balance Patch we have focused on some of the attributes of all positions. Moreover, we have also made some adjustments that were resulted in the Freestyle 2 1Q Survey. Focused on the CT position which ranked 1st as the position that needed a buff and the PF position which ranked 1st as the position that needed a nerf.

In our Skill Patch, a new CT skill has been released and the PF’s upgraded middle shot steps have been adjusted, for further details please refer to the context below.

In our Mastery Patch, the overall DG and PG Masteries have been renewed.
In particular, to PG’s 3-point success rate, attribute has been added that our ballers have consistently been requesting, and we believe the ‘Long range ↑’ skill in the ‘Scheme Breaker’ Mastery will bring a more aggressive PG play style than before.

Please check the details in the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/9a7e8b2467d7289fc93d32b15f79c89c235c9c5b.png

A. New CT skill Added

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/93aaa9ddfd4b0c37229e21f8da0f06816723435d.jpg
Application: A new passive skill ‘Box Out Master' is added to the CT position.

Intention: A Passive skill ‘Box Out Master’ added which provides significantly faster box-out movement than box out upgrade. CT was the top position in the 1Q survey that required the most Buff, and many said the CT position was not unique compared to other Big Man positions. The previous CT position’s scoring ability was lower than the Scorer's, rebound and block weren’t stronger than the Big Man position. After receiving continuous Feedbacks from the users, we decided to add specialized features in each position, C (rebound), PF (block), and CT (box out). “Box Out” will be CT’s concept, and CT’s position will be modified along with his “Box Out” Concept.

B. CT_Hand-to-Hand Skill Adjustment

Application 1 : Pass-and-run can be triggered after using hand-to-hand skills

Application 2 : The Character’s moving speed increases temporarily after receiving the Hand-to-hand pass

Intention: The goal is to increase CT's use of hand-to-hand pass and affect the game plays. The Previous Mastery Skill (hand-to-hand & faster!)’s has been added to apply to the basic skill.

C. Passive Step Adjustment

Application: PF's middle Shot Upgrade 2 skill has been lowered to middle Shot Upgrade 1.

Intention: This had the most opinions in our 1Q Survey, and as a fact, the PF position had a high middle shot success rate and manual dunk gave PF a high advantage in both offense and defense. Reduced the PF Position’s success rate and the reduced number can be achieved through PF’s offensive Mastery.

D. Default skill Changes

Application: C, PF Position’s Dunk Success % II, Dunk Focus_2 skill has been excluded from the default skill.

Intention: High dunk success rate and increased skill slots allowed to meet both offense and defense. Two passive skills were excluded from the default skill to select options of defense or attack skills.

E. Spin move Lay-up skill Adjustment

Application 1 : Stamina reduction value Increased when using Spin Move Lay-up.

Intention: We believe the Spin Move Lay-up skill had been used excessively without any risk under the rim, therefore we have added the stamina reduction value in order to prevent users from using spin move lay-up multiple times.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/6e32d17936b2e4a154214f9f63da603e15893612.png

A. Mastery Skill’s Applied Value Changes

a. L Cut (SG) : L cut Dash Stamina Removed, 'L cut speed' skill’s moving speed Increased
Intention: After when the stamina reduces when using a dash, it was impossible to use the L Cut skill efficiently because of additional dashes were reduced when using L-cut. Stamina Reduction has been removed when using L Cut in order to use to let users use L Cut several times during their offense turn. Moreover, increased moving speed when ‘L cut Speed ↑' skill was equipped.

b. Post-up jumper (SF) : Post up jumper Distance Limit Deleted
Intention: We determined that the previous Post up Jumper skill was not practical enough because the offense player was only able to use the Post up Jumper skill in narrow post areas or in front of the defense player(opponent) that had high block attributes.
Therefore, we removed the Distance Restrictions to increase the diversity and efficiency of SF's attack routes.

c. Hand-to-hand & faster! (CT) : 'Hand-to-hand & faster!' speed Increased, Dash Duration Decreased
Intention: The character who receives a hand-to-hand pass will have faster moving speed but will have decreased duration.

d. Dash Move Speed (All) : ‘Dash move speed ↑’ Value Decreased
Intention: Due to Fast Dash Moving Speed, efficiency of supporting defense was excessively too high, therefore we have reduced the speed by about 60%.

B. Mastery Skill Adjustment

a. Center (C)
Each Skill Attributes’ Increase and Decrease have been partially modified.
Please check the details in the game.

b. Power Forward (PF) 
Each Skill Attributes’ Increase and Decrease have been partially modified.
The Middle Shot Success% has been added to the power dunker Mastery, while the middle shot success % Reduction has been added to the rest of the masteries. Moreover, Box Out Swarm Move Upgrade skill has been added to the Energy Lob Catcher Mastery.
Please check the details in the game.

c. Control Tower (CT)
Each Skill Attributes’ Increase and Decrease have been partially modified.
Please check the details in the game.

d. Small Forward (SF)
Each Skill Attributes’ Increase and Decrease have been partially modified.
The placement of the Standard Forward Mastery has been changed so that 'Shot Fake Drive Speed↑’ and ‘Shoot Fake Drive Range↑’ skills can be learned step by step.
Reduced Rebound Increased value and increased the reduction of the shot success% in the Option Lob Catcher Mastery.
Please check the details in the game.

e. Swing Man (SW)
Each Skill Attributes’ Increase and Decrease have been partially modified.
The placement of the Mastery has been changed so that 'Shot Fake Drive Speed↑’ and ‘Shoot Fake Drive Range↑’ skills can be learned step by step.
Please check the details in the game.

notes.title: Street Block System Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/4dd43d6b94d58e4de5dd0fe68f0802cf8fc4b917.png

Street Blocks, the long-awaited replacement for the Toy System, is now here! Check out our guide on how to use the Street Block System!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/73373d9c07d8eb18dad7a8bda99caae0ff6c0a50.png

What is Street Block?
- Street Block is a 3 month basis system that it will initialize all the points, blocks, 
plates when the season ends.

What is Block?
- Shapes with various stat bonus that can be rotated and dropped inside
the block plate.

- Each block represents stats that will be added on the character attributes.

You can acquire Street Blocks by purchasing them using Block Points. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/610ecd6bbc29725468d7433c050ef0a0b48cd583.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/188bda3e25b7a395688c23041ef42df158346b35.png
- Total number of current Block Points.

What is Block Point?
-Block Points are acquirable through regular matches (game plays), event rewards, 
and also when in the court lobby waiting for matches.

-Ballers can purchase the block box, expand zones, level up or change the
 blocks from using the block points.

1 Day Acquisition Limit: 0/1200

** The 1 day acquisition limit is only for block points acquired with regular 
match and block points acquired when waiting for matches.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/0ae9ee21c6606161ee5b7da437fe2e3427f1f402.png
The Block Boxes contains Blocks which have various stat bonuses in them.

Use the Block Points you amass to purchase Jumbled Block Boxes!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/ba5ff1cf9ed6ec2746cc62d26e75336a445ab5dd.png

 Each block is unique and no other block will contain the same stat bonus.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/391566999051b658d689c5d391e3eb52391bdcc0.gif

This is the list of blocks which the Jumbled Block Box contains.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/8720894e675da2cdcfd36c61c7cb039e188edb0c.gif

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/0d174e3de700fc9a2a60bb56761b1237a02776d0.png
- Part of the Street Block Screen that shows the lists of added attributes from the blocks.

The attributes will apply to the game by rounding the decimal point.
Note: Less than 0.4 attribute values will not be shown in the character additional attribute screen.
(0.5 attribute and above = +1 in the character additional attribute screen)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/0933917d23fac0ab04f3e1291e11411d944e1a48.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/6fa1111a75682c4e79e6764d9cecda006717f274.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/dd447075fbff509258c69b5f3e15387897cd0dd3.png
-  Area where you the street blocks will be placed.

You have to get creative in order to maximize the given Zone that you have! If you feel you are running out of Zones, you can increase the area of your zone with Block Points.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/13f94a2811a6f7fc4c5e9e8fd29204b7e34d2f13.gif

- All street blocks that are acquired from the Jumbled Block Boxes will be visible in this area.

If you have multiple similar blocks, you can combine them in order to increase the stat bonuses that they provide!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/f80f482a399c83b4121b81187aadfc9d3327de6d.gif

Equip the Blocks to the given Zone in order to benefit from the stat bonuses they provide!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/57b0d6dbb1044fe5adba3144fc9371efeae75c52.gif

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/b2ac2055e4169ee348d1b965f6d2fc52a4dbf4fd.png

- Part of the Street Block screen where the Season # & Season Period is shown.

The blocks that you acquire will last for a total of 3 months before they are initialized. But don’t worry! 5% of the total block points that you have earned will be credited the following season! 

Every new season will introduce new exciting forms of zones for you to creatively add your blocks to!

notes.title: Balance Patch 2019.04.24
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/5c9ebadc66a6ce071d75f83980d4e061fd5d8248.png

Hello Ballers, this is the Freestyle 2 Developing Team.

We would want to thank all of our ballers for loving our Freestyle 2.
We have read the Survey Feedbacks and applied a small portion of the feedbacks in our new Balance Update. We will continue to listen our ballers’ feedback and balance each position’s strengths.

★ Skill Patch

 A. Skill Remove 

 Application :  PF’s Skill Remove – Steel Will
 Intention :   Even though the defenders had a good defense against the strong dunks of PF, offense team PFs were still able to make points. However, when it comes to scoring PFs, we believe that Still Will is an important skill for them, therefore we have decided to put the skill in the Offense Mastery.

 B. Passive Skill Change 

 Application :  Passive Attribute 48 → 36

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/a1292f12969460689e2a477aa077f52aa8f1ab55.png
 
 Intention :  Reduced Passive values in order to reduce down the High success rate of Dunks.
 
C. Skill Adjustments 

 Application :  Added Stamina Consumption at Hook Shot Pass and Jump Pass.

 Intention :  Due to the use of too many Jump Passes and Hook Shot Passes, it is showing that the offense players are having more advantage under the Rim. Therefore we have lowered the high frequency use of Jump passes by adding Stamina Consumption to the skills.

 Application :  Reduced 1/4 of increasing speed of the mastery skill “Dash move speed ↑”

 Intention :  We have adjusted the corresponding mastery skill’s speed because we believe the Defense Range had been too broad due to fast speed in mastery skills and high equipping rate of Dash Move Speed.

 Mastery Update 

 The Masteries of C, PF, and CT positions have changed globally. 

 Application :  C, PF, CT position’s mastery placement and skill change

 Intention :  The selection of Masteries has widen than before, each mastery has been clearly divided by the unique type to provide users broader selection and give a chance to choose that suit one’s self and to consider own fitment.


Center (C)
We've mitigated a significant reduction in the initial attributes. We believe that the burden of selecting and equipping masteries will be greatly reduced. Also, we believe that compared to other masteries, the hook shot pass’s attribute has been reduced too much, therefore we have decreased the reduction. Please check the details through In-Game.


Power forward (PF)

We have clearly divided the Power Forward’s Offense and Defense Masteries over the previous Masteries. In the offense mastery of PF, we have increased the reduction in the block attributes more than the rebound reduction. Also, Power Forward playing offensive tactics with defense mastery did not suit our intention, therefore we have reduced the offensive attributes in the defense mastery. Please check the details through In-Game.


Control Tower (CT)

We have mitigated the reduction values of CT’s initial attributes. We have set and divided the Control Tower’s Mastery to show its uniqueness, Quick Lob Catcher to become an Original (Rebound, Block) Big man, Floor Spacer to become a Scorer (Dunk, 3 Points) Big Man, and Option Man to become a Utility (Movement Speed, Pass) Big Man. Also, Dunk-at-Will skill has been added to the Mastery Tree. Please check the details through In-Game.

notes.title: 2017.07.05th.Patch.Notes
notes.notes:
The balancing patch is taking effect this July.  

There are many summer prizes and events so please see the new updates below. 

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1498041682039.png

1. Big series player (C/ PF/ CT) 
i.	Modified swim bug in PF position 
ii.	Modified Free style condition in PF position 
iii.	Get the new indomitable will skill in PF position 
iv.	Get post push skill in C, PF, CT position 
v.	Get middle shot focused skill in CT position 
          
2.	Scorer and guard series player (SF/ SG/ DG/ PG) 
i.	SG 3 points shot resistance improvement  
ii.	Scorer position skill rebalancing: 
Breakthrough fake/ back roll turn &back dribble/ shot fake breakthrough/ quick change handling improvement 
Away screen move skill's speed buff time decreased
Get the enhanced diving catch skill in PG position 
Get the enhanced breakthrough skill in DG position 
Get the enhanced breakthrough skill in SF position 
                Get long range skill 
Get middle shot focused skill in SW position 
            Get the enhanced pass skill in SW position 
iii.	Provide new skills 
Drift pass (SF, SW, DG)
Brilliant breakthrough 2 (SG, SW, SF/CHN, GSP)
                Back roll turn 2 (SG) 
                Breakthrough fake 2 (SG, SF, SW, DG, PG)
               
3.	Related to all positions 
i.	Screen swim move basic skills 
ii.	All positions can purchase screen body check skills 
iii.	Screen: decreased stamina on continuous use of screen, when the away screen move skill is activated, screen cancellation time is extended  
iv.	After the success of the away screen move, increase the screen swim probability when you get on the screen. 
v.	The defender movement speed is temporarily increased when an indirect hit with a defender in areas under than the basket  

	Additional details 
- Drift pass 	

* This is a skill to pass to the nearest team member after diving into input direction in a traveling and pivoting state. 		
* When a good drift pass is successfully activated, it ignores the defender. (Good drift pass is applied when the distance is far enough from the marker or the defender tries to block the pass) 
- Tactical changes
Freestyle 2 requires more careful and close team play on offense which will
improve away screen move tactics.
Together with side effects with tactical improvements 
The away screen move, which is one of the Freestyle tactical moves, will be   
changed from an unconditional move to a conditional skill.

- Rolling back to the December Patches Away Screen Move Tactical Patches
(away screen move will occur when a screener and a receiver are in conflict, 
when away screen move is used, the screener will get away from the screen)
- Screen Swim Move skill is given to all positions as a default skill
(Skill to avoid screen)
- Screen body check is given to the previous position as purchasing skill
- Extend screen cancellation time (extend only when away screen move is    
 triggered)
- When an away screen move is triggered and the defender is caught on the   
 screen, the screen swim move probability is accumulated
- Away screen move skill's speed buff time decreased
        Because of the risk of using consecutive screens on non-risk screens in the 
        pick play tactics, the screen has been changed to be used more carefully.
- When using screens continuously, stamina will drop
- When the defender and indirect offender collide, the defender's movement 
  speed is increased

notes.title: 2017.06.7th.Patch.Notes
notes.notes:
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495637797370.png
Greetings ballers. 
As you all have been expecting, this month is our 3rd Year Anniversary! 
To celebrate, we are having many events and giveaways to thank our ballers that have been playing FS2! Also the Wild Rookies have finally come out! Check out these mischievous SPC characters today! See below for the latest news and updates this month!

Happy 3rd Year Anniversary!

To celebrate our 3rd Year of gaming, we have prepared three giveaway events! 

 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495630360600.png 
Login during the Event period to receive the 3rd Year Anniversary Outfit and Title! We are also giving out tickets for the new SPCs!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/7521

 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495630410864.png 
We are giving out alot of prizes for 5 lucky winners every 30 minutes during the event period! Be sure to check when the Raffle's are happening as they are only open during the specified event times!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/7520

 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495630791713.png 
Let's celebrate 3rd Year of FS2 with a 30% Chance up on Card Balls and Item Balls! During the event period you will get a higher chance to get awesome items!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/7519

 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495630860819.png 
Play the 3rd Year Anniversary Ticket Ball! Collect tickets in the Ticket ball mode and exchange them for the 3rd Year Gift Box! The Gift Box contains awesome prizes and Wild Rookies Tickets!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/7518

 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495630943661.png
The mischievous Wild Rookies have come to the FS2 courts! These new SPC characters are some what different to our usual SPCs. You will be able to transform to Villains and gain unlimited Freestyle! The Wild Rookies also have a +50 Training Point! 
You will find the Wild Rookies in the SPC Vending Machine. The Package contains a whoping [SPC Exclusive Cards, Skill Slot x3, Wish Cards x2]
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/7522

AFK Boot system added

An AFK Boot system has been added to the game. If there is no key input for a long period of time during a match, you will get a pop up message informing you that the game will close soon. You will be given 10 seconds to move and if there is no key input, the game will close.  
** The match will be considered as a loss for users that are on the same team. The user that got kicked out due to AFK will not get any rewards for that match **

 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495631153895.png 


 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495631280465.png
For a limited time only, the Special Skill Box is on sale in the capsules! Step up your game with these special skills!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/7524

 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495631344212.png 
Equip your all new Wild Rookies with these Effect Freestyles! You will be shooting Fire balls and lightnings for every single shot!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/7523

 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495631395887.png
Check out the all new Dreamworld Unicorn outfit in the itemballs!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/item/7517

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/6399

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1487075332486.jpg

 Position Balance Adjusted  
1.Small Forward
A. High Middle Shot success rate adjusted
-After the last balance patch, the success rate of Middle Shots while
in the presence of defenders was abnormally high, especially the
Drift Shot
 
-The success rate of Drift Shot has been reduced to a certain degree.
 
2.Control Tower
A. Hand to Hand Pass effectiveness increased
-Hand to Hand Pass was added to create different strategies and 
connections during Post Up
-Due to the short range of the Hand to Hand Pass receiving motion 
the skill was less effective.
-The range of Hand to Hand Pass receiving motion has been increased

3.Swing Man
A. Tripping Prevention I control difficulty decreased
-Due to difficulty in control keys of this skill, 
it was hard to utilize the Tripping Prevention I skill
 
-Controls have been made easier by also allowing the 
control keys to be pushed before the collision happens 
to use the Tripping Prevention I Skill.  You no longer have to press
Direction key + A exactly when you collide in order to use this skill
 
B. Scoop Shot effectiveness increased
-Experienced users were able to predict Scoop Shots and defend
it with ease
-Scoop Shots can now be connected with Jump Pass to 
create new offense strategies
 
C. Back Block
Back Block activation error fixed
-When having Back Block equipped, even blocks from the front 
activated the Back Block skill
-Adjusted so that Back Block is no longer activated if 
your character is in front of the opponent
