notes.title: 2016.12.07th 'Rebound' Update Patch.Notes
notes.notes:
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479907199926.png

Hello, Ballers!

Project Manager of Freestyle2, Lucy is here to talk about 
our 2017 future plans  and December update!  Ballers in the Rookie Channel will no longer be able to learn Skills with 
   Lv. 24 Requirement or higher even if their Character Level is above Lv. 24.

> Skills that used to have an unlock level of 24~50 have been adjusted to all have a Lv. Requirement of Lv. 24.
   You will be able to learn all skills when you enter the Pro Channel!

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479895880733.jpg

The trouble every Baller goes through is in deciding which stats to choose to upgrade for your playstyle! 
Now check which stat effects which part of your gameplay right inside the game!

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479897855219.gif

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479895916658.jpg

The time taken to open items continuously has been reduced .

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479895953346.jpg

Tutorial for New player has been updated.

http://i.giphy.com/3o6Zt8lU2xG6e5VIFq.gif

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479896007491.jpg 

The crowds surrounding the court is turned off when you set your Graphic settings to “Low Quality”

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479897959855.jpg

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479896039425.jpg

Playstyle Balance Adjustments

1. "Dash" playstyle
> Defending Dash playstyle has been made easier.

- Away Screen Move
  Teammate will no longer get a speed boost when an opponent collides with Screening player.
- Away Screen Move will not be activated during Screen Collision.

Before:
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479899287742.gif
After:
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479899287742.gif

2. "Isolation" Playstyle

 > Defense resist of Dunks and Layups have been decreased to provide higher 
feedback to successful defensive plays.

1.  Success rates have been increased during No Mark chances.
2.  Defense resist stats have been added to defensive moves.
       >  Defense resist against Standing Defense added.
3.    Success rate of Dunks and Layups are decreased when opponents 
       use defensive moves. 
4.    Defense Resist attributes effectiveness increased

3. "Pick&Move" controls improved
Improves team play between positions and adds new offensive playstyles for Big man.

- Press [A] + [Direction Key] after using Screen to use Pick&Move .
(Pick&Move can be used if keys are pressed during Screen collision)

4. Rebound/Chip Out skill balance

- Chip Out’s Card Sub attributes effectiveness has been decreased .
- Rebound’s main attributes effectiveness has been increased.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479908461877.jpg

Small Forward 

New Skill: Spin and Drive
This skill allows for new drive fake timing and various driving patterns

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479897060833.gif

1. Press [V] Key while Driving to use skill

2. This skill can be used in either direction of the Drive

3. Collisions during Spin and Drive are the same with Dribble collisions

4. Combination actions possible
     >  Press [Direction Key] + [D] Key to connect with a quick Jump Shot
     >  [Direction Key] towards Post + [D] Key to Layup

Middle Shot adjustment

1. Middle Shot Success rate according to distance has been adjusted
      > The normal range of Middle Shot has been reduced
      > Middle Shot attributes effectiveness has been increased

2. Middle Shot Focus Skill: Defense Resist attribute effectiveness slightly increased

Control Tower

Attribute adjustment

1. Middle Shot +26 / 3pt Shot +12
2. Short Dunk -13 / Long Dunk -13 / Short Layup -13

Skill adjustment
> [ Middle Shot Focus III ] decreased to II

New Skill: Post Up Keeping
The Post Up Keeping skill allows you to connect with other moves such as Drives 
and shots to provide various offensive strategies

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479897223736.gif

1.Hold [W] Key when receiving ball

2.Combination actions possible
    a. Post Up Dribble ([Direction Key toward post])
    b. Turnaround Fadeaway ([Direction Key away from post] + [D] Key)
    c. Post Up Cut in Drive 
        > While Post Up Keeping hold [Left or Right Direction Key]. 
        > Drive Fake with short key presses
    d. Connect Post up Keeping with Post Up Drive Fake or Backward Two Step

Hand to Hand Pass
Skill has been adjusted so that Hand to Hand Pass can be used while 
Post Up Keeping or Post Up Dribbling

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479901868535.gif

a.Pass to a close teammate during Post Up Keeping or Post Up Dribbling 
b.Press [S] Key while Post Up Keeping or Post Up Dribbling
c.Adjusted so Hand to Hand pass can be used while Post Up Dribbling

Post Up Drive Fake II changed to Post Up Drive Fake III

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479896952556.png

1.Controls

A.Post Up Drive: During Post Up Wind Up [Left or Right Direction Key facing post]
B. Post Up Drive Fake Shot: While Post Up Drive Fake press 
[Direction Key opposite from drive] + [D] Key
C. Post Up Drive Fake Pivot Shot: While Post Up Drive Fake Pivoting press 
[Direction Key opposite from Pivot direction] + [D] Key

2.Post Up Drive Fake Pivot Shot mechanic

A.Press only [D] Key to Jump Shot
B.To Post Shot or Layup press [Direction Key towards post] + [D] Key
(Jump Shot if not in Layup range)
C.To Post Reverse Layup press [Direction Key away from Drive] + [D] Key
(Drive Fake motion if not in Layup range)
D. If [D] Key is not used this leads to Drive Fake motion

Swing Man

Backward Dribble
Enhance Drive patterns

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479901844504.gif

1.Press [A] + [Direction Key away from post] at beginning of drive
2.Dribbling is possible after using Backward Dribble
3.The Backward Dribble skill can be combined with [A] Dribble skills

Tripping Prevention skill improvement
Actions have been added when colliding during drives to enhance SW position

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479901803970.gif

1.While Drive Collision press [Direction Key] + [A] Key
A.Press [Left or Right Direction Key facing post]: Side Hop Step combination
B.Press [Direction Key away from post]: Back Step combination

Added skills from other positions
Add more ways to make shots for SW

> Added skills: Jump Pass / Floater
>Scoop Shot skill improved: The position of Scoop Shots have been adjusted

We are always looking to improve our gameplay for our ballers. 
We hope this balance patch makes our game much more fun and competitive! 
See you on the courts!

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479907118349.jpg
One ‘Training Reset’ and ‘Character Specialty Changer’ will be given to all
the ballers that log-in within the event period from 12/07 ~ 12/25 23:59 once 
per account.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479915256516.png
Card Moving System is now added to the game!

Card Transfer is limited! So better choose the cards that you wish to transfer wisely!

Check out this link more more details: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/gameguide/gmguide/5312

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479904177260.png
Try your luck in the card balls to obtain your desired legendary cards!

We have doubled the chance to get legendary cards for limited period only!

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5311

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479904149110.png
The unique training suits designed by Total and Sancay are now 

available in the Capsule Shop for limited time offer only!

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5310

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479904072598.png
Quest for the net as we open Crew League Season 6!

Enjoy crew league point x 2 during this season!

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5309

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479904017962.png
Let’s make the Crew League System more interesting by completing the 

Crew League Challenge Missions! 

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5309

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479903961762.png

Control the rebound and Collect Random Box Reward!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5308

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479903811680.png
Decorate the Christmas tree and earn Tree-mendous rewards!

Link:http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5307

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479903778579.png

Log in everyday and heap awesome items for free!

Check this link for the reward List:
http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5306

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479903709258.png

Calling all users who haven’t log in to the game for 90 days?
 
This event is solely for the returnees!

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5305

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479903593329.png
Check out the new items this December in the in-game shop.

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/item/5304

Enhance Drive patterns

notes.title: About the upcoming update!
notes.notes:
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479452135518.png

Hello, Ballers!

Project Manager of Freestyle2, Lucy is here to talk about upcoming update on December 7th!

We are preparing a lot of exciting new contents for the upcoming December update. I know you guys were super curious about the upcoming *mystery* update, so Lucy has come to give you some hints on what’s coming up in the future! First off, we have chosen Rebound as our theme for this new update because we believe that this update is going to be a game changing moment for FS2 and we will be bouncing back in action like rebounding in basketball.

(Yes, I know that the theme seems like we’re going to add a super new Rebound skill or redesign all Centers and PFs but it was more intended to send a message/meaning) 

But get excited because we’re planning to have a lot of cool events and awesome rewards in this upcoming Rebound patch. So stay tuned! We are also going to have a “Big Announcement” regarding one suggestion that you guys have been talking about in the forums and in game a lot. Since we are planning Q&A sessions such as ‘Ask Lucy a question’ soon, don’t forget to write down any questions you want to ask her!
It’s getting pretty chilly outside so stay warm and safe! 

We’ll see you on the Courts!

notes.title: New Crew System Bug Fixes & FAQ
notes.notes:
1. There is no Crew Rankings! I want the old Rankings back.
- Unfortunately, the previous ranking has been replaced to the Crew League
Ranking. The Crew EXP system has been removed and there will be no
Crew Rankings based on the Crew EXP. This is mostly likely the new update
for the Crew system.

2. My contribution points are gone!
- Same as Crew ranking, we have removed the old contribution points and
started a new one based on your attendance and Crew League participation.
 
 
3. No staffs/admins/leader/vice-leader/managers can invite/accept someone 
or someone's application if they wanted to join a specific crew.
- This bug has been fixed today.
 
 
4. Whenever we, as a crew team tries to contribute/play together - then
the match finishes, it doesn't give us any Crew Points.
- We have revised the previous GM guide to make this issue clear.

Please be informed that unlike on our previous Crew EXP system, Crew Coins
can ONLY be acquired by completing the following:
 
1. Crew Attendance Mission
2. Playing a Crew League Match
 
We will have a Crew League more often so every crew can have a chance to get the Crew Coins.

For more details regarding this matter, please check this link:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/339610/announcements/detail/851553645898549975

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!

-Team FreeStyle2

notes.title: Crew System Update
notes.notes:
Check out our new and improved Crew System that will give you and 
your crew members more reasons to play!

There will be no more Crew Exp. system it will now be replaced with “Crew Coin”.

Crew Coins will be the main key of this brand new system,
 so let me explain about Crew Coin first!

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459441686008.jpg
- The “Crew Coin” is a new in-game currency that is earned by the Crew and used only in Crew System. 

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459441724406.jpg
- With the Crew Coins, players can level up their crew, purchase Crew Buffs. 
- Also, players will be able to customize their own Crew Uniform and 
Crew Emblem with Crew Coin later. (This feature will be available after 3rd Crew System Update.)

I.	CREW MAIN SCREEN 

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459446708643.PNG

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459442913281.jpg

You can view these Crew Members in this section of the main screen: 
Crew Master, Vice-Crew Master, Star Player and Manager(s). (Up to 5 players)

Here is a list of new roles and explanation.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532242111.jpg
1)Crew Master (1 Baller)
Crew Master can assign crew members to a various roles and have a highest authority.
Crew Master can assign other Ballers as their Vice-Crew Master and Manager.
 
Crew Master Access Level and restrictions:
1.Can change the Crew’s emblem
2.Can appoint and dismiss the Vice-Crew Master or Manager
3.Can Invite and kick crew members
4.Can post and delete recruitment notice
5.Can approve and deny Crew Recruitment application 
 
2)Vice-Crew Master (1 player)
Vice-Crew Master has the same authority as Crew Master.

Vice Crew Master Access Level and restrictions:
1.Can appoint and dismiss the crew Manager
2.Can Invite and kick crew members except the Crew Master
3.Can post and delete recruitment notice
4.Can approve and deny Crew Recruitment application 
 
3)Manager (No limit)
Manager has authority to invite and accept a player to his crew.
 
Manager Access Level and restrictions:
1.Can Invite crew members 
2.Can approve and deny Crew Recruitment application 
 
4)Crew Member
Crew Members have no authority.

**New Feature: Crew Master Change
Crew Masters can be replaced if the Crew Master does not login for a 
month or leaves the Crew. 
 
It will be automatically given to other Baller based on this priority list.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532337703.jpg

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459442925581.jpg

-Part of the crew “Main” screen where you can find the basic information about your crew
such as crew name, crew level, Total Crew members etc.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532429681.PNG

A.Crew Level
- There will be no Crew Exp system.
Previous Crew Ranking page will be replaced to Crew League Ranking. 
Also, all Crews need to start again at Crew level 1.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532479817.PNG

Level up your Crew with Crew Coins, and unlock the various types of Crew Buffs & Crew Buff Slots!

Here is a list of Crew Coin cost that you need for leveling up your Crew.
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459533411369.PNG

B.Crew Emblem
-Distinctive badge that represents the crew; 
Feel Free to change the Crew Emblem anytime!
- Crew Emblem customizing feature will be updated later.
 
C.Crew Coin
- This section shows the total number of available Crew Coins. 
Crew Coins Only can be acquired by completing 

1. Crew Attendance Mission

2. Playing a Crew League Match
 
F.Crew Buff
- You can unlock up to 2 more Crew Buff Slots by leveling up the
Crew level. Players can equip only certain Crew Buffs for each slot.  

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532633034.PNG

- You can purchase Crew Buffs depends on your Crew level by
purchasing a Buff in Management tab. The higher your Crew level
the more buff you can purchase.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459443632421.jpg

Login and clear the Daily Attendance Mission with all Crew Members to 
reach the step 7 before Monday!! This is the most efficient way to collect Crew Coin!

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532698643.PNG

A.Mission Countdown Time
-It shows how many days and time is left until the deadline (Every Sunday 00:00)
 
-Reward will be given on every Sunday 00:00 based on the attendance steps the Crew reached by deadline.
 
B.Step Counter
- Progress bar that shows the current status of your Crew’s Step goal
 
C.Attend Button
-Each Crew Member needs to click “Attend” button in order to complete the certain goal for each step.
-You cannot participate yet if you have just joined the crew.
-Steps will increase when the goal is reached.
 
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532773485.PNG

-The Crew Master can write a message or a reminder for Crew Members 

II.CREW MANAGEMENT SCREEN
- Crew Master/Vice-Crew Master can purchase Crew Buff using the Crew Coins here.
 
- Crew Buff is a buff that will affect all Crew Members.
 
- Purchased Crew Buff will be expired after 3 or 7 days. 
Crew Master has to purchase a new Crew Buff after the expiration date.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459444121510.PNG

A.Equipped Crew Buff 
-There are 3 types of Crew Buffs you can equip.

a.Growth Crew Buff

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532872781.jpg

b. Function Buff – Function Buff Slot unlocks at Level 4

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532899226.jpg

c. Attributes Buff – Attributes Buff Slot unlocks at Level 7

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532920448.jpg
 
III.MEMBER LIST SCREEN
- This screen is where you can view the list of crew members
- You can check the character name, current channel that they are located in and
the time of their most recent log in.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459445042929.jpg

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459533025462.PNG

a.Total Crew Members
-Denotes current the total number of your crew members
 
b.View Online Members
- You can filter the list and view the current online members
 
c.Invite Crew
- Only Crew Master, Vice Crew Master and Manager
can send Crew Invitation to other ballers
 
d.View Message
- You can view your crew members’ note for the crew.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459445241149.jpg

- Recruit New Crew Members
- This tab can only be accessed by the Crew master, Vice crew master and Manager

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459533109642.PNG
-To recruit a new crew member, Click the “Recruit Crew Member” Button, 
and fill out the basic information.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459533144983.PNG

New Feature: Join Now 
-By checking this option, the system will automatically accept player
as a crew member when they click the “join now” button at the
Crew recruitment page. There will be no application submit-> accept process.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459533183725.PNG

You will also be able to check the Crew League info under the Crew Page.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459533211934.PNG

Stay tuned for more updates coming soon!

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532429681.PNG

A.Crew Level
- There will be no Crew Exp system.
Previous Crew Ranking page will be replaced to Crew League Ranking. 
Also, all Crews need to start again at Crew level 1.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532479817.PNG

Level up your Crew with Crew Coins, and unlock the various types of Crew Buffs & Crew Buff Slots!

Here is a list of Crew Coin cost that you need for leveling up your Crew.
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459533411369.PNG

B.Crew Emblem
-Distinctive badge that represents the crew; 
Feel Free to change the Crew Emblem anytime!
- Crew Emblem customizing feature will be updated later.
 
C.Crew Coin
- This section shows the total number of available Crew Coins. 
Crew Coins Only can be acquired by completing 

1. Crew Attendance Mission

2. Playing a Crew League Match
 
F.Crew Buff
- You can unlock up to 2 more Crew Buff Slots by leveling up the
Crew level. Players can equip only certain Crew Buffs for each slot.  

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532633034.PNG

- You can purchase Crew Buffs depends on your Crew level by
purchasing a Buff in Management tab. The higher your Crew level
the more buff you can purchase.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459443632421.jpg

Login and clear the Daily Attendance Mission with all Crew Members to 
reach the step 7 before Monday!! This is the most efficient way to collect Crew Coin!

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532698643.PNG

A.Mission Countdown Time
-It shows how many days and time is left until the deadline (Every Sunday 00:00)
 
-Reward will be given on every Sunday 00:00 based on the attendance steps the Crew reached by deadline.
 
B.Step Counter
- Progress bar that shows the current status of your Crew’s Step goal
 
C.Attend Button
-Each Crew Member needs to click “Attend” button in order to complete the certain goal for each step.
-You cannot participate yet if you have just joined the crew.
-Steps will increase when the goal is reached.
 
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532773485.PNG

-The Crew Master can write a message or a reminder for Crew Members 

II.CREW MANAGEMENT SCREEN
- Crew Master/Vice-Crew Master can purchase Crew Buff using the Crew Coins here.
 
- Crew Buff is a buff that will affect all Crew Members.
 
- Purchased Crew Buff will be expired after 3 or 7 days. 
Crew Master has to purchase a new Crew Buff after the expiration date.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459444121510.PNG

A.Equipped Crew Buff 
-There are 3 types of Crew Buffs you can equip.

a.Growth Crew Buff

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532872781.jpg

b. Function Buff – Function Buff Slot unlocks at Level 4

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532899226.jpg

c. Attributes Buff – Attributes Buff Slot unlocks at Level 7

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532920448.jpg
 
III.MEMBER LIST SCREEN
- This screen is where you can view the list of crew members
- You can check the character name, current channel that they are located in and
the time of their most recent log in.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459445042929.jpg

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459533025462.PNG

a.Total Crew Members
-Denotes current the total number of your crew members
 
b.View Online Members
- You can filter the list and view the current online members
 
c.Invite Crew
- Only Crew Master, Vice Crew Master and Manager
can send Crew Invitation to other ballers
 
d.View Message
- You can view your crew members’ note for the crew.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459445241149.jpg

- Recruit New Crew Members
- This tab can only be accessed by the Crew master, Vice crew master and Manager

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459533109642.PNG
-To recruit a new crew member, Click the “Recruit Crew Member” Button, 
and fill out the basic information.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459533144983.PNG

New Feature: Join Now 
-By checking this option, the system will automatically accept player
as a crew member when they click the “join now” button at the
Crew recruitment page. There will be no application submit-> accept process.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459533183725.PNG

You will also be able to check the Crew League info under the Crew Page.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459533211934.PNG

Stay tuned for more updates coming soon!

Rookie & Major Channel will be merged.
But don’t worry! The ELO system has been improved upon this 
channel merge, so you will not be facing teams that are too strong.
 
-New & existing baller ELO rating system update
Default ELO points will be changed according to the Baller’s status 
and highest character level
 
a. New baller’s ELO default point / minimum point : 300 ELO points
  - Even if you keep losing, ELO point won’t go down below 300 ELO points.
 
b. Default points for the ballers who do not have a character
over Lv.20 in their account : 700 ELO points

over Lv.20 in their account : 1000 ELO points

your account.

notes.title: February 17th Game Update: Crew League System, Improved Card Slot UI, Community Server Merge, FS2 Lite Version, New event and Item Shop Update
notes.notes:
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454508527781.png
System update and changes

[1] 1st Crew System Update: Crew League
Crew league system has been added.

Crew related Updates will be serialized in 2016, keep an eye out on the FS2 website.
Check this Crew League Guide here:
http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/gameguide/gmguide/2891 

[2] Channel merge
There will be changes in some of the channels after this updates.

1.Pro and star channel will be merged for due to the following reasons below:
-Many ballers in Star channel will play Crew league this month and the number of players in Star channel won’t be enough.
-Most of Ballers who made new positions have reached the appropriate levels.

2. Rookie channel change
> No more level restrictions in Rookie channel
- Except Asia server, ballers can enter the Rookie channel if the character is below level 12 regardless of the highest level in the ballers’ account. 
-To High level Ballers:
After removing a level restriction, some of high level ballers might
indiscriminately do Smurfing / Evicting new players which create a big barrier for the new players. 
      
Ballers, when you are playing in rookie channel, please help new ballers learn how to play well and get along with them.

Channel merge are as follows:

Asia Server

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454508941569.png
** Rookie channel level restriction as before.

EU/NA server
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454508952866.png
** Ballers will be able to enter the Rookie channel if the character is below level 12 even though they have characters over level 12 in their account.

[3] Improved UI of the Card slot
UI of Card slot is improved for easier Equip/Remove/Upgrade.
Character card filter has been added to that Rare/Legends can be sorted.
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509148294.png

[4] Community Server has been merged.
Along with the Crew League Update, the community server has been
merged for smoother synchronization of Crew related data. So now you can see your friend’s log-in status when your friends log-in to other servers.
 
Ex) When Lucy plays at Asia server, there will be a notification when Dime logs-in the EU server. 
 
But because the physical servers are different, you will not be able to use these functions with your friend who is in another server:
1. Following  
2. Room Invite
3. Wisper

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509295314.png
The new function that will indicate where your friend logged-in will be added soon with further updates.

[5] New Feature: FS2 Lite version (Beta)
> This feature is only available on Gamekiss Client at this moment.
- When you install FS2 for the first time, you can download the minimum
game data and start playing using the Lite version. This new feature will let you play before the download is finished. 

While playing, the Launcher will download the rest of the game.
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509474383.png

-Full client download progress will be shown on top.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509552313.png

-Once you download the minimum data of Lite version, you can log-in
        and play at Lite version.

-After finishing download of Full Game files, you can play at Full version by restarting of FS2 client.

Lite version has some limitations which are as follows:
-Limited outfit options (You may not be able to change clothing)
-Every card has the same image. 
(There will be only 3 types of Card images: Defense/Offense/Talent)
-Sound limitation (Only 1 BGM can be used)
-Court limitation (There will be only 1 type of court (map))

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509689361.png

-Every toy will appear as below:
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509743306.png

[6] Awesomium version update
-You can now view the Notice in Windows 10.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509819366.png

[7] Removed Toy package
Limited sale Toy package has been removed.
Shark Toy Random Box
Octopus Toy Random Box
Diodon Toy Random Box

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509900556.png

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454503602727.png
Check out the new outfits available in SAKUN and Mileage shop!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/item/2894

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454508166943.png
Be as powerful as dragon in FS2 court with these Haaxsin Dragon masks only available in Capsule for limited time only!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2897

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454508126655.png
Never got the item you want in the Events? Now you can get the item you want among 18 other items in Coin shop! You can collect the Coins by justlogging-in for 120mins or playing matches. Don’t miss out on this opportunity to get various New Permanent FX items! 
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2896

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454503658163.png
No teammates? Don’t be upset anymore. You can do Dirty Dance alone now. 
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/notice/2895

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454508201434.png
Club League Opening! This BIG chance will never happen again! 
You will get 1500 Mileage when you achieve 10 wins in a row at Crew Match!Do you know how much you need to consume Gkash for 1500 Mileage? It’s 30,000Gkash! 
And there are Special rewards such as 50 Epic Coins and Character Specialty Changer too. Don’t miss it!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2898


-Team FreeStyle2

notes.title: Crew League System Update
notes.notes:
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454423063659.jpg

Let’s make your FreeStyle2 experience even more exciting with this new system!
Let’s achieve a new goal which is different from Crew Tournament.
Let me introduce the new system which all the Crew members can participate, 
the Crew League System!
 
** Notes **
 
1. Only the Crew Members who already joined the crew before the Crew League starts can receive the Crew League reward. 
So you MUST join a crew before the league starts.
 
** Crew master cannot evict the  members during the Crew League event period.
 
2. Only the Crew Member with character level 12 or up can join the crew league

[1] Crew League open time
- During the Crew League Event, 
Crew League System only opens during the time below:

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454306034446.PNG
        
-‘Crew Match’ button will be activated only for the Crew Master / Member with character level 12 or up.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454421409643.PNG

 [2] What is Crew League? 

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454307962387.png
 
1) Crew Tier
Crew Tier will change based on Crew points after the Crew match. You can view the conditions by clicking the button.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454421599796.PNG
** Tier will be refreshed & changed every hour.

2) League
There are 2 types of Crew Leagues:

  a. Challengers League
  Every Crew can join Challengers League for the first 3 weeks.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454421687929.PNG 

  b. Masters League
  After the 3 weeks of Challengers League, Master’s League will open for 1 week and it is exclusively for the Top 30% crews in the Challenger’s League ranking.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454421819626.PNG

  -Crew League Rule
  Crew League has Individual ranking and Crew ranking.  A Crew member 
  with the highest Individual Crew point will be chosen as the Star   Player. 
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454421906693.PNG

3) Crew League Timer
It will inform the opening and closing time of the Crew League.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454422100344.PNG

notes.title: January 13th Update: New Positions (CT/DG), Star Channel Update, Match reward system update, New player care system, 'Post up keeping’ and more events!
notes.notes:
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451488918541.png

Greetings Ballers,

Please check out the notes below for the details of the game update today!
 
1.'Post up keeping’ state has been added
Now you can use new motion : Post up keeping by press [W] without pressing any direction key right after receiving the ball. 
All positions can use ‘Post up keeping’ now, and Control Tower can use 
the exclusive skill [Hand To Hand] right after [Post up keeping] motion.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451486328817.gif

2. New Position: Control Tower / Dual Guard

A. What is Control Tower and Dual Guard? 

Control Tower is often called the 'Passing Center'. 
This position has both a Centers Rebound ability and PG's Passing ability.
 
Dual Guard specializes in driving skills and has both the SF’s and PG's abilities.
 
B. How to create CT/DG?
1 .In order to these positions, player must have a certain position character with lv12 or above in his account.
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451496783596.PNG

2. It must be created with Lv.12 character. (Basic or Special Character)

Special Characters
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451496830003.jpg
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451496802532.png

** You can't create CT/DG/SW with buzzer beater character because 
there is no Lv.12 buzzer beater coupon.

**lv12 basic character. (Costs 48,000 Points to create lv.12 basic character.)

C. New special skills for CT

video link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-s2zo-4_gCs

1. Deny Intercept (lv.8)
Automatically catch the ball when you defend a pass
 
2. Pass And Run (lv.16)
Make a short dash after making a pass
 
3. Power Tab Pass (lv.28)
Tap the ball towards your teammate denying the opponents
 
4 .Hand To Hand Pass (lv.36)
Pass to a teammate while in a post up keeping position
(hold [W] key in Triple Threat state)
 
D. New special skills for DG

Video Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Da_KiNuRNnM

1. Rolling Diving Catch (lv.6)
-Catch a loose ball by somersaulting for it
** This skill’s catch distance is longer than PG’s Diving catch.

2. Pass And Run (lv.16)
Make a short dash after making a pass
 
3. No Mark Shot (lv.28)
Increases your chance to make a shot when you are not defended
 
4. Jump Shoot & Pass (lv.36)
Pass during a fake jump shot 
 
3. Star Channel Update
Channel was divided by 2 channels due to the increasing users of the Lv.25~39 
by new position. But after monitoring, it can be combined again. 
Channels division is as follows: 
[Pro: Lv. 25~39/ Star: Lv. 40~50] 

4. Match reward system update
Instead of getting the reward by opening the box, items will be given to the 
locker directly after match.

5. Card sub-attribute changer system has been closed
This function is not available anymore. 
 
6. New player care system
Tutorial system for new player has been updated. 
It will teach you how to equip skills, purchase skills and use attribute point in detail. 
This system is only for the users whose highest level of characters is below Lv.6.

7. Megaphone Update
The speed of in-game Megaphone motion has been adjusted.
If the content of your message is short, the text on your megaphone will not move.

8. Black Lightning SP Uniform pkg
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451487338734.png
Did you know you can make any of the new positions (DG/SW/CT) 
with Black Lightning SPCs?
 
This is the great chance! Because you can buy the most awesome 
exclusive SPC uniform package! Check out the awesome package
here:http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2861

9. Sakun Outfit Capsule
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451487414632.png
You can get the unique Sakun outfit through the capsule! 
Sakun attribute is +7 but adding attribute on Sakun outfit is cheaper than Rare items! 
Check out this: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2860

10. Make your own Items! Event
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451487560901.png
You want to get an Animation item in DIY system but it is too hard?
Get new Animation items during the event period! 
There are 2 special items you can get ONLY in this event. 
Some of materials can be acquired ONLY in DIY Material Random Box.
You can get DIY Material Random Box by playing 4 times in team match or just purchase it with 30 Gkash!
Check this out for more information: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2859

11. Shop item update
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451487740101.png
Mileage shop and item shop was updated.
Check out the new outfits for January at: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/item/2858

12. Log-in 7 Days Straight!
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451487872555.png
Login everyday and get what you want! If you miss a day for log-in, 
it will go back to Day 1 because it’s Cumulative Log-in Event!  
Please keep in mind!
** If you claim a reward, it will reset to Day 1. 
So you need to wait and log-in until you can get an item you want!
Check this link for the rewards for this event: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2857

13.FS Time
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451488002799.png 
This Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Enjoy 100%+ Exp & Point Buff!
Check this out for more details: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2856

SG or SF character with lv12 or above in his account.

No tripping while drive collision
 
2.Post Up Drive Combo (lv.24)
Able to connect to various dribble while post up drive
 
3.Side Hop Step (lv.30)
While in Drive Dribble, jump toward the side quickly to keep distance from defender

Layup shot with an underhand scooping motion

-	Summer Rafting (Legend, Pro)

-	I’m Here (Legend, Pro)
-	Toy Edition #1 ~#5 (Legend, Rookie)

A. Card skill bug fix
The card skill has been updated. We have fixed some issues related to card skill 
and now you should be able to use it. You can use certain skill once you complete
the card deck!

It doesn’t matter which position you are! 
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447851743509.png

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447877449770.JPG

B.  Card ball update
1. Fly to the Sky (Offense/Defense/Talent)
2. Summer Rafting (Offense/Defense/Talent) << Specialized Card for Swingman Position
6 cards have been added to card ball.

C. Card Fusion

Players were not able to get these cards from Card Fusion because of minor bug.
These cards have been newly added to Fusion card result list, so players should
be able to get these cards from Card Fusion after this update.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447877472182.JPG

3. Reporting Players 

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447852549623.png

Now you can report players directly after the match.
You do not have to send additional report beside this.
 
1.You can report ill-mannered or hack users you played a match with. 
(Only recent 5 matches)
 
2.You can report same character only once per a day.
 
3.Please write a report with detailed description. 
 
Ex) please check [3:24] from this match’s replay file. He is sliding too much!
 
Once you report, server will automatically send us the replay file of 
suspicious player’s match. 

FS2 GM team will review and check/update how many times each player
has been reported.

4. Xigncode has been added.
 
We changed our Anti-cheat engine from Hackshield to Xigncode.
 
This anti cheat engine is commonly used in many online games and is updated
constantly whenever especially when they find new illegal programs. 

The FS2 team is taking rapid action against the hackers and we are trying our best so
that honest Ballers are not affected by these hackers. 

We will keep updating our Anti-cheat engine from time to time. 
 
If you have any issues related to Xigncode, please don’t hesitate to contact us at 
steam_support@gamekiss.com.

5. OX Queen Update

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447849624892.png

Ballers be ready! The "Ox Queen" is here to show off her Swingman Skills! 
She will be joining the “West” SPC!

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447848685671.png

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/807

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447845593447.png
Get this Reindeer X-mas Pkg for limited time only and Be Santa’s favorite Reindeer this season!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/806

8. Roll the Dice!

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447846207851.png

Be a mighty baller that is powerful as a horse with this Gold Horse head from the 
Roll the Dice event!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/805

9. FS Time!
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447844718830.png

Ready to enjoy?
 
Let’s have fun together and I’ll see you guys soon in the Game Lobby!

notes.notes:
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437567948678.png 

From the breath-taking Buzzer Beater team to the aristocrats’ Noble team, another extraordinary team 
will be added on Freestyle2 Basketball to make every match unforgettable!

Check out the video and meet the ultimate rival of the Noble ones, the indigent Black lightning team.

 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=diX66PULmcU


It’s time to take sides and battle it out on the streets “Team Noble or Team Black Lighting” which team will you side with?
 
Come and join the “Special character competition” event and take your favorite team’s side and win this battle to prove who the best is!

 Event Period: 
 
8/5~8/25 23:59:59

How to Participate:
 
1.)	Select a team “Noble” or “Black Lighting” 
(The team you select will not affect game play)

 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437566901305.png 

2.)Start playing matches for your team! Win or lose you will earn points for the team you joined.
 
Note:
- Get 3 points for winning a match and 2 points for losing.
- Points can only be earned from 3v3 team matches
- If you have an SPC that belongs to the team you selected you will earn a bonus of 100pts!
 
3.)Earn points to unlock special items! So keep playing until you unlock them all by reaching the 
point requirement.

  http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437566919230.png 

4.)At the end of the event both teams will be rewarded win or lose, the winning team will receive a better reward.


 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437564278450.jpg 

Being a Noble has it perks! Grace and her mega corporation has developed what she calls the
“Enchanted Wallet” how this wallet works no really knows except her and her team of scientists.
 
But what it does is quite impressive as it can help ballers from all over the world achieve almost a “Noble” status.

 Event Mechanics:

1.)	You must first Purchase one of “Grace’s Enchanted Wallets” to participate in this event 
and you can only buy one of the wallets for a limited time only 8/5 ~ 8/18. 

 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437570074592.jpg  

2.) Log-in everyday to get Event Cash! You can get Free Event Cash each day for up to 30 days.
 
(Log-in for 30days and complete the reward list!)

 Enchanted Wallet (100 Gkash) Reward list  

 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437563516105.jpg 

  Super Enchanted Wallet (500Gkash) Reward list 

 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437563532068.jpg

What is Event Cash and how do I use it?
 
When buying a premium item you can only use regular Gkash or Event Cash.

1. Event Cash is the currency you earn from the “Enchanted Wallet” from logging-in.

2. If you have more Event Cash than the price of the item Event Cash will be consumed first.
 
3. If you have fewer Event Cash than the price of the item but have enough Gkash, your regular Gkash
    will be consumed.
 
4. If you both don’t have enough Event Cash or regular Gkash you will not be able to purchase the item.
   
5. Mileage  will not be awarded for using Event Cash

6. Event Cash will expire after 60 days.



 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437561522086.png 

Get this Hot Summer outfit that will brighten up your carefree summer days from the 
Hot Summer package and Random box! Check this link for more details: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/newsdetail.jce?newsId=670



 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437560409949.png 

Event Period:
 8/5~8/11 23:59:59

Event Details:

Get 15% More Bonus Mileage for every cash-item purchased during the event period!
You will get 20% Mileage in total (5% Basic Mileage + 15% Bonus Mileage) for your every purchase!

The more cash items you purchased, the more bonus mileage you get!
So get ready and purchase items!

 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437559735738.png 

Check out this link for the trendy outfits this August!: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/newsdetail.jce?newsId=667

notes.notes:
http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1432296497159.png 

Greetings Ballers!

Today, We have updated the trading cards, badges, backgrounds and emoticons on Steam!
http://i57.tinypic.com/sczyoo.pnghttp://i62.tinypic.com/qsl1zm.pnghttp://i60.tinypic.com/2qncc3o.pnghttp://i62.tinypic.com/e6xhmw.png
What is Steam Trading Cards?

Steam Trading Cards are virtual cards earned by playing games on Steam. Sets of cards can be turned into game badges and tradable Steam community items.

Do free to play games drop trading cards?

Free to play games drop game cards based on your in-game purchasing. For every $9 USD spent (approximate), you will earn one card drop. This card will drop at some point as you play.

What is a badge?

A badge is an icon on your profile (and tied to your account) that represents the trading card sets you've collected or your participation in an event.

To know more about this Update, You may visit this link: http://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/faq/
and

notes.title: Easier way to patch the game (before April 29th game client)
notes.notes:
Did you install FreeStyle 2 before April 29th?

There is an easier way to patch the game just browse the FS2 local files and click on launchersteam.exe

How to do this? Follow these steps:

1. Right Click Freestyle2: Street Basketball and Click Properties

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1429785509035.png 

2. Click Local Files Tab and choose Browse Local Files

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1429785710349.png 

3. Double Click LauncherSteam.exe

 http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1429785750708.png 

This will cause the game to patch and download the latest update directly and ignore older files on steam.

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1429785797284.png

The latest version of FS2 is now

http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1429786081407.png

By following the steps above, you do not have to download the 16GB patch files.

- Team FreeStyle 2

notes.title: Gamepad controller support update on April 15th
notes.notes:
Greetings Ballers,

Did you know that FreeStyle 2 will be released on the Playstation4 later this year?

Well that’s a different story we can save for another day.

The FS2 dev team has heard your requests so we will be adding game pad support for FreeStyle 2: Street Basketball on PC.

Not everyone can show off their fancy moves using a keyboard and giving more options to do so only will only improve the FreeStyle experience even more for everyone.

Controller support will be added on April, 15
So get those thumbs ready for some FreeStyle 2 action!


-Team FreeStyle2
